text:
Most Recycling Is a Waste
Metals and some plastics are worth separating, but the rest of it is costly and can hurt the environment.

I recently finished an ice cream in Copenhagen and found myself stumped at the trash bins, wrapper in hand. Denmark sorts its garbage into 10 official categories, so that throwing something away becomes a small bureaucratic exam. The bins embody an idea that has gone too far: that more recycling is always better.

Modern enthusiasm for recycling was turbocharged by the 1970s panic that the world was running out of resources. But the biggest item households recycle is paper, and we aren’t running out of trees.

The case for recycling then shifted to protecting the environment. That argument has some merit. Recycling plastic can save oil. But heavy glass has to be collected, trucked, cleaned and remelted. Almost anything can be recycled if you throw enough money and energy at it. But are the benefits worth the cost?

Valuable materials were long recycled without government programs to make it happen. A century ago, scrap supplied about 30% of America’s copper, close to the 32% recycled globally today. Iron, steel and construction debris are recycled because businesses find it profitable.

Yet governments have increasingly pushed citizens to recycle paper, glass and plastics worth less than the cost of collecting and processing them. Sometimes the environmental benefits made up the difference. But over time the means became the end.

Governments in Europe and North America now chase suspiciously round numbers. The European Union sets mandates for 90%, 85%, 80%, 75%, 70%, 65%, 60%, 55% and 50%, covering everything from beverage containers and packaging materials to municipal rubbish. In 2010 Scotland promised “zero waste” with 70% recycling by 2025. Its household recycling rate stands at 44%.

The world now spends more than $250 billion a year managing municipal waste, perhaps $50 billion of it on recycling. That money can’t go to policies that do more good.

A new study from Denmark’s Environmental Protection Agency shows the trade-off. Mechanical post-sorting of household trash nationwide would lift Denmark’s recycling rate by almost 5 percentage points toward EU requirements. By the usual scoreboard, that is a win.

But the costs far exceed the benefits. Each ton of carbon dioxide avoided would cost nearly €4,000. That’s almost 50 times the European carbon price, meaning emissions can be cut far more cheaply elsewhere.

Even California’s governor has begun asking whether another recycling rule is worth the cost. Last week Gavin Newsom vetoed a bill tightening requirements for recycled-content claims, having concluded that it would bring “little benefit.”

Recycling for its own sake can do harm. For decades, rich countries collected low-value plastic and shipped more than a quarter of it to China and other poorer countries that promised to recycle it. Much of it was never recycled. One U.S. study found that about one-fourth of exported plastic scrap was unusable, and half of that was badly managed. This trade fell sharply after China’s 2018 import ban, but even in the years immediately afterward perhaps 5% to 10% of land-based plastic entering the ocean came from plastic that wealthy countries had virtuously collected for recycling.

Some recycling clearly pays, but the question is how much. Japan, which publishes the world’s best data on municipal waste, offers an answer. One peer-reviewed study estimated the socially optimal recycling rate—the point at which benefits, including environmental ones, most exceed costs. It was 10%. A newer study finds that municipal management costs alone were minimized at 7.6%. Recycle less and you miss cheap gains from metals and plastics. Recycle more and you pour ever greater resources into ever smaller gains, leaving society worse off.

A much-cited U.S. analysis imagined a suburban county designing its waste system from scratch. It tested every combination of recycling, landfill, incineration and anaerobic digestion. The best social outcome? Collect everything in one bin, send it to a central sorting plant, pull out recyclables and organics by machine, turn the organics into biogas and soil amendment, and burn the rest. Roughly half the waste ends up incinerated, 38% digested and 12% recycled. One bin instead of 10, with the best mix of low cost and environmental benefit, delivered by machines rather than by hectoring households.

Official accounts ignore a cost every household pays: the time spent sorting. Peer-reviewed studies from Sweden and Finland find it takes 26 to 29 minutes a week per person. Value that time at half the minimum wage in each country and it comes to €43 billion to €47 billion a year across the EU, about as much as the entire cost of Europe’s municipal waste system. Across the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development’s member states, it amounts to $111 billion to $123 billion.

Recycle what is worth recycling. Then throw away the idea that more recycling is always better.

Mr. Lomborg is president of the Copenhagen Consensus, a visiting fellow at Stanford University’s Hoover Institution and author of “False Alarm” and “Best Things First.”

text:
The univers and the human Brian are the same lattices This series is a stack of three different subjects that were kept in one formal write-up. They are not the same thing.The format. You asked for answers in the style of a Dark Horse “white paper”: headers, equations, tables, and a signature block. After that, each reply ended with an offer of the next calculation, and you pasted that offer back. So the thread walked, one step at a time, through warp-drive math, then a real biology paper, then a made-up network of “fidelity” numbers.The warp-drive part. The metric is the Alcubierre bubble: a patch of flat space that is slid forward by a shift, like a conveyor belt, so a ship inside does not feel acceleration. The price is negative energy in the wall of the bubble. For a 10 m bubble moving at light speed with a moderately thin wall, that negative energy is about a thousand Earth masses. Thinning the wall does not make the total go away; it piles the same kind of stress onto a thinner shell. None of this has been built. It is a geometry that needs exotic matter the universe has not supplied in that amount.The biology part. The X post is Sergiu Pașca’s Stanford group, whose Nature paper is on the cover. They engineered mice so most of the cortex and hippocampus never form, then filled that space with human stem-cell cortical organoids. The human tissue grew to about 92 % of the cortical volume, sent some long axons, showed slow spontaneous calcium bursts (tens of seconds on, minutes apart), and partly restored a simple maze-alternation behavior. The tissue is still immature, roughly late-fetal stage. The paper does not claim the mice are conscious, human-like, or quantum.A ordinary brain-wave model with a slow “fatigue” variable already produces bursts on that minutes-long clock. Microtubule quantum ideas (Penrose–Hameroff) were checked against the same clock. Even the more generous decoherence estimates die in a ten-thousandth of a second or faster. The bursts you can record are millions of times slower. So the organoid activity does not show a quantum brain.The “nodes” part. That was bookkeeping inside the Dark Horse language. Fidelity (F) is a score from 0 to 1 on a small graph. Wall nodes were pinned low; interior nodes relaxed. Adding a link to a low node pulled its neighbor down; deleting the link let it rise. Those numbers (about 0.79 and 0.62, or 0.54 and 0.57) are solutions of that toy graph. They were not measured in the mice, and they do not cancel the negative energy of the bubble.The one-sentence version. A warp bubble, on paper, wants impossible negative energy; a mouse with a human cortical graft has slow, classical-looking bursts and partial behavior changes; a fidelity graph can be tuned by hand. The series calculated each of those separately and refused to treat them as one machine.

🔐 https://t.co/Q1sjn8NCyl — In the Age of Super Intelligence, Who Really Owns Your Digital Future?

The next great technology battle may not be fought over who builds the smartest AI.

It may be fought over who controls the intelligence, data, and digital assets those systems create.

Think about what is happening.

𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗨𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗔𝗟 𝗔𝗖𝗖𝗘𝗟𝗘𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗢𝗥 𝗔𝗖𝗧 (𝗜𝗔𝗔) : 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗔𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗗𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗖𝗘𝗦𝗦 

 Yesterday was the deadline to table amendments to the Industrial Accelerator Act, a complex dossier addressing many of the competitive imbalances our industry faces globally.
 
 While some in the EPP propose rejecting the Commission’s proposal, with clear internal divisions and no common baseline, @socialist and the Socialists and Democrats Group in the European Parliament have worked together to give it a clear direction: strengthen industry, defend jobs and turn the industrial transition into an opportunity for growth, security and EU autonomy.
 
We seek a level playing field, with options for countries with EU trade agreements, while avoiding populist protectionism that could harm our own industry. It is a delicate balance; negotiations will determine the outcome.
 The amendments I coordinated with colleagues in ITRE, IMCO and INTA complement the joint S&D position led by Pierre Jouvet, Kathleen Van Brempt and Jens Geier .We want this law to meet the needs of our businesses, workers and regions. 

Our priorities:
- Manufacture energy transition Tech in Europe. Stronger EU component requirements for wind, solar photovoltaics, electricity grids and their digitalisation in public support schemes. Energy investment must also strengthen our factories, capabilities and suppliers.
-  Clear “Made in Europe” rules. For steel, we propose requiring it to be melted and poured  in the EU. For electrified vehicles, at least 70% European added value across the supply chain, including parts and components from European industrial suppliers.
- Foreign investment that creates value in EU . Legal certainty for foreign investors that have already chosen Spain and Europe for new industrial activity, alongside stricter conditions for new investments: jobs and sourcing from European suppliers.
- Industrial acceleration areas compatible with environmental protection. Excluding Natura 2000 sites, taking local climate risks and regional development levels into account, and allowing cross-border areas with Portugal or France.
- Support for Europe’s maritime industry. Addressing its competitive disadvantage caused by global market distortions, protecting its value chain, and allowing industrial acceleration areas. A broad definition must include shipyards, equipment manufacturers and the maritime supply chain for offshore renewables: specialised vessels, subsea cables and offshore wind infrastructure.
 The energy transition offers to Spain and Europe an industrial opportunity we must seize. This legislation must strengthen strategic industrial capacity, reduce dependence on third countries, support the deployment of renewable technologies and energy infrastructure manufactured in Europe, and attract foreign investment that creates jobs and economic value for our communities.
This is the industrial policy we stand for.
One of our AMs👇

text:
ARC Raiders Frozen Trail 2.0 is now out!

Patch highlights:
• New map: Pendola Pass
• New map conditions: Frigate and Redirection
• New enemies: Bully, Skulker, Hydra
• New weapons: Bantam and Stiletto
• Amplified Weapons
• Revamped Skill Tree
• New items: Grappling Hook, Basic and Advanced Cameras, Tether Launcher, Yank Grenade, Mountaineer's Detector, Banjo and Harmonica
• The Outpost, including a new Research Bench
• Lootable Design items that unlock craftable Outpost furniture
• Quest changes, with 22 new quests
• New Reward Pass system
• Weapon Stencils
• Updated default gamepad mapping
• Reworked Map Selection screen
• Collector DLC is available now
• Stash can go two levels higher, to 328 without Expedition bonuses

Skill Tree:
• Middle of each branch is now one choice between two skills. You can pick again after a reset
• End of each branch has two nodes. After the required skill point spend, you can take up to two of the three skills
• Fight or Flight stamina is up about 25% per level. Stubborn Mule regen is up about 33%. Back on Your Feet healing goes from 30 to 40
• More skill changes are likely as Embark watches how people use it

Weapon Stencils:
• 14 stencils: 5 on the Frozen Trail Premium Pass, 1 in the DLC, 8 found Topside
• Learned like blueprints, then applied to compatible weapons with Stencil Parts from Topside
• A downed Raider can still lose the weapon, stencil included

Outpost:
• Unlocked by completing a project. Accept the quest and bring a camera
• Can be expanded with modules. Unlocking it also opens the research station
• 100 Furniture Designs added: 4 on the Frozen Trail Pass, 1 in the DLC, 73 found Topside
• Designs work like blueprints and are used to craft Outpost furniture

Reward Pass:
• Cred is removed. Reward Points now go to whichever pass is active
• Frozen Trail Pass has 60 levels, with a Free track and a Premium track
• Old Raider Decks move to the Legacy Pass. Rewards already unlocked stay granted
• Only one pass can be active at a time

Feats:
• Easy: 15 Reward Points, +1 weekly milestone progress
• Medium: 25 Reward Points, +2 weekly milestone progress
• Hard: 50 Reward Points, +3 weekly milestone progress
• Three weekly milestones, 250 Reward Points each, at 4, 8, and 12 progress
• Feats can still be finished after that, but the milestone rewards wait for the weekly reset

Twitch Drops:
• Oxygen Respirator at 60 minutes, Mailbox at 120 minutes
• Live October 8 to November 4, 2026

Content and bug fixes:

Animation:
• Knockback now matches the direction you are pushed
• Fixed jitter and broken movement animations after reconnecting and being revived
• Fixed getting stuck on small obstacles while sliding
• Added map and inventory interaction animations, proximity-chat mouth movement, exhaustion after running out of breath, and a dust-off after sliding
• Fixed items staying in hand during knockout or some interactions

ARC:
• Vaporizer multi-target laser gives a clearer dodge window
• Fire status visuals added for ARC drones
• Higher-tier Queen and Matriarch leg loot moved from the armor pieces to the leg pieces. Armor can still hold some loot
• Rare enemy detection errors reduced
• Matriarch can use all of its ranged attacks again
• Physical force against some ARC rebalanced

Audio:
• Character sounds occlude more naturally through walls and obstacles
• More metal groan variations
• Snap Hook now has attach, detach, and rope sounds
• Skill Tree unlock sound updated, with a hold-interaction cue
• Fixed some weapon sounds failing to play
• Raider Voice model quality improved

Cosmetic:
• Celeste's appearance updated
• Backpacks with lights have an emissive toggle, so the lights can be turned off
• Zenith Outfit now has its intended toggles. Owners should get the missing ones shortly

Gameplay:
• Solo vs. Squads is no longer a matchmaking option while Embark reworks its role
• Explosive damage vs ARC reworked. Hullcracker deals over 50% more to armor plates and about 30% less to fragile parts
• More contextual ping info for ARC and objects
• Stash max is 328 without Expedition rewards or Nomadic Envoy space
• Loot can be dropped to the ground from containers
• No sprint-climb on ladders while exhausted
• Fixed some vaults onto destroyed ARC or other movable surfaces launching the player
• Weapon slot weight reduction applies only to the loadout
• Map can be opened while downed
• Better hit registration when shooting from on top of ARC
• Heavy Shield durability decay cut from 0.20 to 0.15. Movement penalty cut from 15% to 10%
• Scrambling: a sprint at a steep slope can carry you up for a short time
• Tumbling too long now drops you into a slide

Items:
• Flame Spray range increased to match the visual
• Placed ziplines break if they intersect something
• Snap Hook range cut from 20m to 18m, durability use from 2% to 4% per use, power cost from 50 to 60. It is meant as burst mobility next to the Grappling Hook, not a straight upgrade. Full power still allows several uses, not instant back-to-back ones
• Items that spawned outside their intended areas or containers now stay in the set locations

Weapons:
• Anvil rarity moved from Green to Blue. Bantam takes the uncommon hand cannon role
• Anvil Splitter is no longer a mod. It is an upgrade option for the Amplified Anvil, and the Anvil Tech Mod slot is removed. Existing Splitters can be sold or recycled into Amplified Fragments
• Jupiter no longer hits ARC parts behind the target twice. Stronger against armor, slightly weaker against weak spots
• Hullcracker no longer looks incomplete in the inspect menu
• Dolabra can destroy the yellow weak points inside the Harvester
• Weapons picked up from the ground keep their attached parts

Maps:
• Doorblockers on small side-sliding doors now sit vertical
• Texture quality improved on several maps
• Fixed downed players getting stuck on terrain
• Some map-edge areas are darker than intended
• Blue Gate: lighting adjusted, and some stuck spots fixed
• Buried City: Hospital Roof is climbable again. Ray-traced lighting restored on boarded shutters. Fixed light bleeding into an interior

text:
Reddit Marketing 101 (you don't wanna miss this)

A part of me wanted to figure out distribution for the longest time, as I am a tech growth person, which means I can code a little bit(mostly Claude code now) and build some good products, too.

So I was lurking around Reddit for the past couple of months to get eyes on my product or any service that I am willing to offer.  Ironically, I got viral posts and viral comments multiple times, which landed me insane job and freelance opportunities from Reddit alone.

You can look at the linked image below.

And no, I never dropped a link in a post DIRECTLY(there is a way for that) or talked about how good I am at something or even talked about anything or had a blocked account.

Reddit isn't like any other platform, ig, and that's what makes it special, and it's insanely hard to crack.  Now, whatever I am trying to do is working, and I will just keep on doing more for my upcoming little products.

Anyways, now the point (how did I do it?)

I followed a couple of steps.

> Mostly talked in the same niche about different problems and added the pure value stuff that I knew or even used AI for the extra hand there(just research, not writing). 

> Promoted my thing directly in some subreddits where it was allowed, although I got blocked from a few subreddits too, but it doesn't matter; I have multiple accounts. 

> Most of the posts that went viral got replies, negative and positive both, and people came onto my profile to check the product (this is what got me views to the product)

> About the AI citations for GEO/SEO/AEO, whenever my post would be going viral, I'll edit the post and then add my link there too. 
(I used to do this for very few subreddits and for very little restrictive ones) - IMP point

> Being in the same niche and talking about different stuff got TOF(top of the funnel) people in the funnel, and BOF(bottom of the funnel) people got converted by the links in my profile and also a ton of testimonials on my landing page too.   

But due to this, now I don't do this. 

Because I started ranking on Google, and most people search on Google, then end up on Reddit or directly on my site and then boom, a sale.  

- Do it very slowly, and without any automation.   

- Add humour, add mistakes while typingg...  Just do more and slower.  

I got a couple of posts with like 120k views, 90k posts, 3k posts, etc. 

Although they are scattered in different niches, but mostly in which is where my product audience is sitting.

text:
The Industry's Strongest Custom Tuning Service? — @final_audio  TONALITE True-Wireless Earbuds Listening report

Overview

final showed its new DTAS digital-mapping audio simulation technology at the FUJIYA AVIC Spring Headphone Festival in 2024. DTAS builds a personal tuning by scanning your full physical body, not just the ear canal — a harder problem than the usual ear-canal measurement. The experience needs brand staff and instruments, and final offers it only as a Japan-only value-added service.

About a year later, final launched TONALITE, its flagship true-wireless earbud built on DTAS. It packs the whole room of gear and people into one app and one pair of buds. Many guessed final's next TWS flagship would be the ZE10000, but TONALITE breaks from past models in both shape and name. The name comes from the French music term 'tonalité' — the key and character of every melody.

How DTAS Works

'No two ears hear alike' is now common wisdom in the HiFi world. We used to blame it on taste plus ear-canal shape. DTAS looks at the whole body instead. final holds that sound reaches the eardrum only after bouncing through the head and body, so each person's build shapes how they hear timbre. A headphone feeds the canal straight, with no body filter — that is why speakers and headphones give two very different listens.

DTAS scans your body shape and builds an 'Acoustic Avatar' carrying your acoustic traits. It computes how that model bends sound waves, then writes the result into the buds. The aim is headphone sound closer to everyday listening. The test now runs in the TONALITE app through a phone 3D scan and a few photos.

First-Time Setup

Your first DTAS run needs the box items: the AR marker sticker, a headband, the original adjustment ring, and the ear tips. Keep them safe. The app first scans your face, crown, and sides with the front camera. Then the buds send a test tone to measure the ear canal and form your avatar.

The app guides you step by step, and key steps need a confirm. Some photos take a few tries. When done, you pick Regular or Personalized sound in the DTAS menu. Personalization has three levels; the middle one is most balanced. The tuning burns straight into the buds and stays — swapping your source gear changes nothing.

Sound

Even with DTAS off, TONALITE already sits at the top of the TWS class. It beats the last flagship, the ZE8000 MK2, above all in resolution and purity. Detail lays out in clear layers, separation is high, and the background is clean. Density is good too. The tuning leans Japanese-house: modest bass, an overall tilt to the upper mids.

Imaging is smooth and clean with no edge. Vocals sit a touch forward, the mouth image is small, and a clear, sweet, soft coloration comes through. It shines on female voices. Treble extension is excellent — transparent and bright, with rich overtones and a full sense of air. With no EQ and no DTAS, the tuning already has a clear lean: a soft, graceful path that suits pop, folk, and small-to-medium ensembles.

Regular vs Personalized

Next to Regular, the DTAS tuning sounds more relaxed and natural. Buds feed each canal on its own, so imaging normally sits at the head's center and the stage spreads out from that point — true of Regular TONALITE too. Flip on Personalized and the stage becomes a ring around the body. Vocals and instruments move to that ring and wrap the listener, giving a real stage feel.

Older space tricks lean on cross-feed: they blend the L/R signals to mimic a speaker stage, pulling the image from head-center to straight ahead. That only copies a two-channel setup and still falls short of a real room. DTAS's stage is closer to everyday ambient sound — spread around you and filtered through the body before it reaches the ear. The wrap is clear with chamber music and jazz; in a piano quintet every instrument's body and timbre stays distinct.

Personalized Low End

The other big shift is low-end naturalness. TONALITE's own bass is clean and tight, with a quick rebound. Not much of it, but plenty of punch. Personalized adds richer overtones and layering, and better flow. Regular stresses bass energy; Personalized moves the focus to how drums and double bass are played.

The rumble feels carried on air, building in steps. It adds no new detail — it just arranges what's there more naturally, so detail is easier to catch.

Fit & Design

Beyond sound, TONALITE fixes what final's older TWS got wrong. The first ZE3000 and ZE8000 sounded great but had bulky shells and a loose canal fit — sore ears on long wears, and high wind noise. The later ZE8000 MK2 kept the same bones, with little real gain. TONALITE's shell is redesigned, close to a melon-seed shape: small, round, and lighter than the ZE8000.

Shell and case wear final's signature "powder-snow" coating — anti-dirt and anti-slip. The insert splits into two parts, with a soft adjustment ring under the tube. A small bump locks onto the concha. The tip sits between foam and silicone: squeezable, springy, and easier to clean than plain foam.

For the best seal, push the tube in and twist the shell so the ring clamps the canal — passive isolation then rivals a custom IEM. If you hate the tight feel, twist to leave a gap: more air, but density and bass texture take a hit.

TONALITE is the most secure and comfortable final TWS I have worn. It is light and burden-free, and its isolation beats the other models. The stock tips do the heavy lifting — don't swap them at will, because the personal test and tuning use them as the reference. A different tip hurts accuracy.

Conclusion

Years in, TWS gear has EQ and protocol updates everywhere. TONALITE takes a different road. final also gives a 10-band EQ in the app, but DIY can't match the natural, relaxed feel of Personalized mode. DTAS's lift to the listening experience is a real leap.

TONALITE brings a service that should be costly and complex to the mass of users — a phone and a pair of buds is all it takes for a private tuning. That novelty rests on truly excellent hardware, and it works for both seasoned audiophiles and casual listeners. It shows final's tuning craft and tech depth, and it marks a step up for the TWS and earbud class as a whole.

text:
Will #Tech Save the #Planet? Scientists Who Believe So Are 23% Less Likely to Join #Climate Protests

Scientists banking on technological solutions to solve the climate crisis are significantly less likely to demand action from governments or modify their personal lifestyles. A international study involving over 9,000 researchers across 115 countries revealed that techno-optimists are 23% less likely to sign climate petitions or join protests compared to their less optimistic peers. The findings were published in #Environmental Research Letters, reports #The Guardian.

When asked whether technology could largely resolve problems caused by climate change, 27% agreed, 44% disagreed, and 29% remained undecided. Even within the scientific community, the majority remains skeptical of relying solely on future technical fixes.

Behavioral differences extended to daily habits: techno-optimist scientists were 18% less likely to adopt high-impact emission reduction measures, such as limiting air travel, reducing car use, or switching to vegetarian or vegan diets. This optimism was more prevalent among researchers with right-leaning political views and those in natural and applied sciences.

Study author Fabian #Dablander from the London School of Economics explains that technological promises offer an appealing alternative—engineered solutions like carbon capture suggest climate change can be tackled without fundamentally revising consumption or personal comfort. However, future tech does not eliminate the immediate need to curb emissions.

Kevin #Anderson, professor at the University of Manchester, described reliance on future tech as a "blue pill" for parts of the scientific community. He noted that certain high-profile researchers express alarm over the climate future while maintaining carbon-intensive lifestyles, accepting unproven technological promises without applying their usual rigorous standards of proof.

Unbelievable, but true…

Amerikansk jury: "Falsk anklagede mænd er ofre for sexchikane"

"I det, der kan blive en skelsættende afgørelse for amerikanske universiteter, har en jury i Maryland fastslået, at en mand, der blev falsk anklaget for seksuelt overgreb, var offer for chikane på grund af køn.

En mandlig studerende, der blev falsk anklaget for seksuelt overgreb, opnåede sidst i sidste måned en stor sejr for retssikkerhed og lige rettigheder, efter at en føderal jury fandt, at University of Maryland ikke beskyttede ham mod alvorlig chikane, efter at han var blevet falsk anklaget og til sidst renset gennem universitetets egen Title IX-proces.

Juryen gav den falsk anklagede studerende medhold — han optræder som John Doe (det navn, amerikanske myndigheder bruger om anonyme personer i retssager. Jane Doe når det er en kvinde) ) i et føderalt søgsmål, som The Daily Wire har gennemgået. Han anklagede University of Maryland for ikke at have beskyttet ham mod alvorlig chikane, herunder en smædekampagne anført af studerende, efter at han var blevet fuldstændig renset for den kvindelige studerendes anklager.

Sagen blev ført for en dommer udpeget af Obama, Paula Xinis. Juryen fandt, at den falsk anklagede mand blev udsat for chikane, der var »så alvorlig, gennemgribende og objektivt krænkende, at den berøvede ham lige adgang til en uddannelsesmulighed  på University of Maryland«. Den fandt også, at University of Maryland »bevidst forholdt sig ligegyldigt over for chikanen«.

Afgørelsen er ifølge mandens advokat, Jason Greaves fra Binnall Law Group, første gang, en jury har fastslået, at falske anklager om seksuelt overgreb kan betragtes som chikane på grund af køn.

»Det er den første sag, hvor en jury har fundet, at falske voldtægtsanklager kan udgøre sexchikane, og første gang et universitet er blevet holdt ansvarligt for bevidst ligegyldighed over for den chikane,« sagde Greaves til The Daily Wire. »Denne sag er skelsættende for falsk anklagede mænd på universiteterne.«

Does søgsmål handlede ikke om pengene, men om at rense hans navn fuldt ud og sikre, at Title IX beskytter alle studerende, forklarede Greaves. Han sagsøgte for 1 dollar, men sejren betyder, at universitetet også skal dække hans advokatomkostninger. Afgørelsen kan desuden danne præcedens for større erstatninger fremover, hvis en skole nægter at beskytte falsk anklagede studerende.

»Vi bad kun om 1 dollar i erstatning, fordi sagen ikke handlede om penge,« sagde Greaves. »Vores klient ville have ansvarlighed.«

»Forhåbentlig har denne jury sendt et signal til universiteter i hele landet om, at Title IX beskytter alle studerende, mænd og kvinder, og at de ikke kan lukke øjnene for offentlige ydmygelseskampagner, hvor falske anklager om seksuelt overgreb behandles som en dom,« sagde han.

»En skole, der vender himmel og jord for en anklager og derefter erklærer sig magtesløs, når den anklagede er blevet renset og bliver ødelagt offentligt, har diskrimineret på grund af køn,« tilføjede advokaten...

.... I sagen fra University of Maryland blev den unge mand i oktober 2020 falsk anklaget for seksuelt overgreb af en kvindelig studerende, identificeret som Jane Roe. Ifølge stævningen blev Doe og en anden mandlig studerende anklaget for at have overfaldet Roe, men universitetets Title IX-undersøgelse fandt i sidste ende begge mænd »ikke ansvarlige«. I sagen fremgår det, at undersøgelsen afdækkede modstridende forklaringer, vidneudsagn, sms’er og endda retsmedicinske prøver, der underminerede Roes beretning, herunder prøver, der ikke fandt sæd på tøj, hun hævdede indeholdt beviser.

Trods frifindelsen sagde Doe, at Roe og ledere af studenterorganisationen Preventing Sexual Assault fortsatte med at chikanere ham offentligt og orkestrerede en smædekampagne imod ham. Han blev kaldt voldtægtsmand, konfronteret på barer, råbt ad, og pressekampagnen endte med at få ham smidt af lacrosseholdet, efter at holdet blev kontaktet direkte og presset til at fjerne ham.

Universitetet nægtede hele vejen igennem at gribe ind og beskytte ham. Han sagsøgte University of Maryland, medformændene for Preventing Sexual Assault og andre for Title IX-diskrimination og repressalier, brud på ligebehandling, ærekrænkelse og følelsesmæssig belastning.

Her er direkte sprog fra Does stævning, som The Daily Wire har fået:

John Doe blev fuldstændig renset for frygtelige og ondsindede falske anklager, men University of Maryland nægtede gentagne gange at beskytte hans rettigheder som studerende. Universitetet lod Doe blive offentligt ærekrænket som voldtægtsmand af studerende, der arbejdede tæt sammen med universitetets Title IX-kontor. Da Doe indgav klager til universitetet om brud på universitetets regler, herunder repressalier og sexchikane, ignorerede universitetet hans klager. Uden andre muligheder indgiver Doe denne stævning mod sagsøgte for kønsbaseret diskrimination, der har medført talrige brud på Title IX i Education Amendments of 1972 (20 U.S.C. § 1681 ff.), brud på hans ret til ligebehandling, ærekrænkelse og forsætlig påførelse af følelsesmæssig belastning."

text:
It's quite a long and painful story but let me try to summarise it.

I went through a spiritual phase in my life. A phase that lead to me being viewed some way by people who didn't understand it. I then lost friends and relationships with people I was close with.

Instead of fighting to save these relationships and for their acceptance, I decided to just isolate myself.

I stopped blaming them for rejecting me because even I didn't understand myself very well in that moment.

I did a self-inquiry that started on a path of self-judgement. I judged myself and concluded that I was the reason why everyone rejected me and I was okay with that.

My intentions were in a good place but the approach was not healthy. So I continued spending a lot of time alone. Connecting with my spirit, nature and God.

The more I spent time by myself, the more curious I became. The questioning and conclusions became less judgemental and more curious. So I forgave the people that rejected me. In doing so I learnt compassion. I started enjoying my own company. I realised that I'm not for everyone.

I became aware that I'm blessed to receive and not entitled. So I stopped having expectations of others and started expecting those things from myself. It was more easier to give myself what I wanted from others because I had a bit of an understanding now.

I was more self-aware. Even aware of the things I can't give myself yet. Instead of being judgemental, I was accepting of the situation and continued learning and working towards that.

It's still a work in progress because there are certain other things we haven't learnt giving ourselves. Not because we don't want to but because we still lack the capacity. So we're working towards that now.

text:
Gross things that happen after you give birth:
1. The first poop is scary. Take the stool softener they offer you. Breathe, don't push.
2. Night sweats. You will wake up soaked for a week or two. Sleep on a towel.
3. You bleed for weeks, even after a C-section. The mesh underwear is your friend.
4. Everything swells. Ice pads look strange and feel amazing.
5. Sitting hurts. A donut pillow or a rolled towel on each side helps a lot.
6. Peeing can sting. Use the peri bottle every single time.
7. When your milk comes in you may leak through your shirt and the sheets.
8. Your hair falls out in handfuls around month three. It grows back.
9. Afterpains. Your uterus cramps while you feed, and it is worse with baby
10. You might cry at nothing on day three or four. That is the hormone drop.

Another beautiful day to wake up, count our blessings, and thank God for the people He places in our lives. 🙏❤️‍🔥

And some are the quiet heroes who simply show up, listen, offer a helping hand, say a prayer, or bring a little light into someone’s darkest moments.

Not all heroes wear capes, and not all acts of heroism make headlines. Sometimes the smallest act of kindness makes the biggest difference in someone’s life. ❤️❤️‍🔥❤️

“Let all that you do be done in love.” — 1 Corinthians 16:14 (ESV)

And since it’s also Thirsty Thursday, here’s to all those everyday heroes! May your coffee be strong, your blessings overflowing, and your glass filled with something worth celebrating later! ☕🍷

Have a beautiful Thursday, everyone! Keep your faith strong, your heart kind, and never stop shining your light!

Good morning and HAPPY TUESDAY! ☀️🍂❤️‍🔥🙏😘🇺🇸

There is so much joy tucked into this life when we actually allow ourselves to feel it. And today, I plan on soaking up every bit of it. 🥰❤️‍🔥😘

NAPS HAT-TRICK IN SIX-DAY ROMP: Daqman completed a hat-trick of naps (and four out of six) yesterday with Kiniro at Kempton Park, and is hovvering decimal points short of 100 profit after six sensational days’ tipping, which are detailed in yesterday’s column. Now add Kiniro in this naps sequence:

WON 6-5 KINIRO yesterday’s nap
WON 13-8 MAGIC MUSIC Tuesday’s nap
WON 4-9 RIDGER Monday’s nap

TODAY: Saturday’s Cesarewitch stats and facts.

TOMORROW: First day of the Newmarket autumn meeting.

CUP HORSE IN A HANDICAP

Bailing out. Layers are sure to absorb the market shock of having a horse who has mixed it with Gold Cup and Classic form in the front line of betting on Saturday’s Cesarewitch.

Likely to get his ground again at Newmarket, last year’s winner of this handicap at the 2m 2f, Beylerbeyi showed how much the trip suits when beaten little more than a length in the Group-2 Doncaster Cup.

But it’s the subsequent display of the Town Moor winner, Caballo De Mar, that will surely make Beylerbeyi short odds on Saturday.

It was thought that soft ground had handed ‘Caballo’ two Group-1 strikes at Longchamp but his Sunday repeat in the French Gold Cup was on good ground and at the expense of the 125-rated Scandinavia, the Ascot Gold Cup and Irish St Leger winner.

His 117 mark must surely be revised, the form continually warning that Beylerbei should be lifted from his 101 by up to 7lb.

As ever, Daqman will be looking to crack the Cesarewitch market with early value offers on the Betdaq Betting Exchange on Saturday morning, when overrounds in single figures are expected to give punters an edge throughout the good-ground card.

Big-odds Cesarewitch winners come on the soft (25-1 in 2019; 33-1 in 2024); otherwise strong punts carry the day, ending up from 9-2 to 10-1 SP in seven out of the remaining eight years of the decade. What might topple Beylerbeyi?

Daqman will be looking for something aged 5, 6 or 7, which account for five of the last six successful; they were weighted from 8st 3lb to 8st 13lb.

The last eight winners came from jumps stables or mixed yards, six of them Irish including three in a row (2018-2020) for Willie Mullins.

I’M NOT STARSTRUCK

⭕ 3.15 Bath (Beckford Stakes Listed Race) 12 fillies and mares head to post for a Listed event that might be more competitive than the Betdaq Betting Exchange implies.

Heading the market is the Team Gosden trained Brilliant Star who is top on the official ratings and making her first start since finishing fourth in the Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot where she gave every impression that the extra two furlongs will suit.

She has every chance on the formbook but doesn’t look any value when you factor in the break she has had and the fact she doesn’t hold any big race entries for later in the season.

Both Pierian and Venetia look realistic alternatives.

The William Haggas trained Pierian made it three winners from six races with a handicap win here last time over 1m 3f. She was staying on well to beat Asset who won at Sandown next time out. This is a step up in class for Pierian but she might well be capable of finding the necessary improvement.

Venetia is already proven at Listed level having won at Goodwood over 1m 2f in June on soft ground. She comes into this on the back of a 40-1 third in a Group 3 at Newmarket and could easily try and make all here.

AIGHEAR HAS ALL THE GEARS

⭕ 5.13 Ayr It’s heavy ground today and that will suit Aighear who absolutely bolted home here nine days ago when beating stablemate Furhaan (opposes again today) by nine lengths and that probably could have been nineteen. Furhaan will struggle to turn that form around.

The 4lb penalty won’t stop Aighear in that kind of form and it’s easy to see why her trainer Jim Goldie is keen to get another run in before the handicapper has his say.
She won this same race last year by four lengths when the ground was also heavy and looks the nap of the day.

NOSTRUM FOR REPEAT WIN

⭕ 8.30 Southwell Nostrum is another last time out winner who I want to be with today.

He came back to form with a win here last week over a mile and shouldn’t be inconvenienced by the drop back to seven furlongs in a race where the handicap debutant Not That Guy looks the danger after he narrowly justified favouritism at Wolverhampton last time out.

BET 1.6pts win VENETIA

In the occult system of Aleister Crowley, moving "forward in reverse" refers to the mandatory training of the magician to think, speak, write, and act backwards. Detailed in his work Liber ThIShARB (Liber 913) and later collected in Magick: Book 4, this process is designed to break down conventional frameworks of time and perception. 

The Law of Reversal
Crowley posited that to perceive the past, understand karma, or discover one's "True Will," an adept must master the Occult Law of Reversal. By forcing the mind to process reality in reverse, the practitioner aims to unlock hidden layers of memory and subconscious power. [1, 2]
According to Crowley’s specific instructions, an adept must train using the following methods:
Writing Backwards: Learning to write text in reverse, using either hand. 
Walking Backwards: Moving physically in reverse to disrupt muscle memory and spatial habit. 
Listening Backwards: Listening to phonograph records or audio clips played in reverse (a practice that later heavily influenced the concept of "backmasking" in music).
Speaking Backwards: Reversing phonetics out loud (e.g., transforming the phrase "I am He" into "Eh ma I"). [1]
Reversed Thinking: Seating oneself in meditation and mentally tracing the day's events perfectly backward, from the current moment down to the exact second of waking up.

Purpose and Cultural Legacy
Magical Aim: Crowley designed these techniques to shatter the psychological illusion of linear time and habitual ego-thought, assisting the magician in cultivating the "Magical Memory" (including past-life recall) and surviving profound spiritual states.

These elements are all uniformly mixed throughout the star. The star "enters" the main sequence when its core reaches a temperature (several million kelvins) high enough to begin fusing hydrogen-1 (the predominant isotope), and establishes hydrostatic equilibrium. (In astrophysics, stellar fusion is often referred to as "burning", with hydrogen fusion sometimes termed "hydrogen burning".) Over its main sequence life, the star slowly fuses the hydrogen in the core into helium; its main-sequence life ends when nearly all the hydrogen in the core has been fused. Meridian is just steps from where Tupac was shot, and right down the street from the strip.  You can see it from the present-day High Roller wheel.

It was extremely popular in the 2000s with poker pros, strippers, and high-end hookers, due to its security features and proximity to the strip.

It was a decent place to live at the time, in good condition, had full time security, and a nice pool.  Everyone renting there was generally well-behaved, and crime on property was almost nonexistent.

Today, not so much.

Starting in 2005, they joined Vegas condo-mania and decided to convert their 1992-built apartment complex into condos.  All tenants would be offered to buy their unit, and if they refused, they would be given notice to vacate.

Since these were apartments, each unit required substantial work to be converted into condos, which would be at the new owner's expense.

I ran into an old lady in her 70s, from another building within the complex, who was clearly agitated and frustrated.

She told me that the tenant next door to her had already vacated, and the complex was doing extremely noisy work on the unit from 7am-7pm every day.  She shared a common wall with this unit, and told me that she was "going crazy" and "couldn't hear herself think".

She had complained to the office, which obnoxiously told her that these conversions had to be done, and that if she broke her lease with 9 months left, they would go after her for every penny.  The work was likely to continue for months, as they had other units close to her also slated for immediate conversion.

They told her that they had aggressive and effective lawyers who would make sure to collect it all from her.

She was on a fixed income and this would have burned her entire savings.  She told me that she was going to try to make it through the next 9 months, even though it would be torturous, because she simply couldn't afford to move and pay two rents at once.

Given that I have substantial knowledge of the rental industry, I immediately told her that this violated her right to quiet enjoyment, which basically states that each tenant has a right to peaceful living in their unit.  In some cases (such as noise outside the property), quiet enjoyment does not apply, but it very likely applied in this case.

Meridian was voluntarily choosing to do the noisy, long-term work on the apartment next door.  I told her they could not do that and still force her to keep honoring the lease.

She thanked me but said she was not good at arguing this sort of thing, especially with zero knowledge in this area.  I offered to go with her to the office, and help her solve this.  She accepted, and we walked down there.

The guy in the office tried to refuse to let me get involved, stating that I wasn't on the lease, and therefore could not speak for her, even though she gave me permission.  I decided to run a bluff, and told him that he could either speak to me now, or my uncle, an attorney, would represent her pro bono and sue the complex.  In reality, while I had an uncle, he was not an attorney, nor was he anywhere near Nevada.

But this scared the guy and he was willing to hear me out.  I demanded he allow this woman to break her lease.  He gave some weak pushback, but I wasn't budging and told him he was clearly violating this woman's rights.  After some argument back and forth, he reluctantly agreed to allow her to move to another apartment for the remainder of her lease -- one which would be nowhere near construction noise.

She was thrilled to hear this, but I then further demanded they pay to move her stuff.  He refused at first, but again, after some argument, backed down and agreed to that as well.  After we left, the old woman thanked me profusely.  I told her I was happy I got this resolved for her.  It was very satisfying.

I stayed until the very last day they'd let me in 2007.  My unit was fine and had no noise.  They wanted something like $460k for my ordinary 2-bedroom apartment -- before conversion costs!  I thought that was absurd, and declined it.  Amazingly, it then ended up selling for over $730k!  This ended up in foreclosure after the 2008 housing crash.

The 2008 crash really did a number on Meridian.  Most people who bought the "condos" did not live in Vegas full time, and had been enticed by lies about the lucrative "rental program", which supposedly would generate huge income for them.  This did not pan out, and the rental program was a failure.  Between that and the massive number of foreclosures there from the 2008 crash, the HOA went insolvent for awhile.

Eventually, this nice complex from 2007 became a ghetto full of squatters, drug dealers, pimps, and rowdy short-term tenants by 2009.  I could have bought a condo identical to mine -- AFTER improvements -- for just $88k that year.  I passed on it.  Part of me wanted to buy it, wait a few years, and resell at a big profit, but it just seemed like too much of a headache.

Anyway, as you can see from the below tweet, Meridian lives on today.

I wouldn't recommend it at this point, but if you're short on cash and want to be close to the strip, I suppose it's still an option.

"Förföljelsen av kristna i Mellanöstern, Afrika och Asien får ingen som helst uppmärksamhet från denna allians. Även om vänstern är hård i sin kritik av kristendomen i väst, kommer den aldrig nära att kritisera islam, trots att kristendomen idag är världens mest förföljda religion och islam är den främsta förföljaren av kristna världen över."

Uppgången och valet av Zohran Mamdani

Kanske det mest framträdande exemplet på detta allianssabotage av väst är Zohran Mamdanis uppgång, en farlig vändpunkt i New Yorks historia. En kommunist som styr huvudstaden i världskapitalismen; en muslim som ekonomiskt och organisatoriskt litade på islamiska organisationer i sin kampanj, styrde staden där islamistisk terrorism slog till för ungefär ett kvarts sekel sedan. Mamdani kombinerar den radikala vänsterns agenda med den islamiska synen på väst. Han är den första borgmästaren i New Yorks historia som tillkännager sin religion efter segern, att han är muslim, och förklarar: "Jag är stolt över min tro, och jag kommer att tjäna efter det islam lärde mig!!" På dagen för sin seger gick han för att fira med sina anhängare i en moské i Astoria, New York, och sade till dem: "Jag är från er och för er." Det är därför många ansåg att dagen för hans seger var en svart dag i stadens historia. Big Apple har hamnat i händerna på en grön-röd allians.

Den islamiska aktivisten Linda Sarsour sade vid en CAIR-konferens den 20 september 2025 att islamiska pengar och islamiska super-PACs spelade en avgörande roll i finansieringen av Mamdani och hans politiska uppgång. Pressen rapporterade nyligen om hennes utnämning till rådgivare åt Mamdani, och Al Jazeera intervjuade henne för några dagar sedan och presenterade henne som sin rådgivare. Det bör noteras att Sarsour har krävt att Mamdani ska avveckla NYPD-enheten som ansvarar för att övervaka terroristhot.

CAIR namngavs i Holy Land Foundations utredningar om terrorismfinansiering 2008 som en opåtalad medkonspiratör. CAIR-organisationerna, registrerade som 501(c)(3), etablerade CAIR Action som en 501(c)(4) för att få rätt till valfinansiering genom anslutna Super PACs såsom Unity and Justice Fund, grundare av en Political Action Committee. Denna fond stödde Mamdani med 120 000 dollar, och enligt deras egen redovisning kom mer än 80 % av finansieringen från muslimer. Det finns en annan CAIR-kopplad fond, Unity Lab PAC, som också finansierade Mamdanis kampanj.
Abdul El-Sayeds uppgång ( Hur många sådana har vi i Sverige?)

Segern för Abdul El-Sayed (Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed) som demokraternas kandidat till senaten från Michigan var ytterligare en chock, större än Mamdanis i New York, eftersom El-Sayed kommer från själva hjärtat av den islamiska rörelsen i Amerika. Han och hans fru, medan de studerade vid University of Michigan, var framstående ledande medlemmar i Muslim Students Association (MSA), en organisation grundad av Muslimska brödraskapet i Amerika som en av flera stora islamiska organisationer, och de träffades genom sitt engagemang i den. El-Sayeds svärfar, Jukaku Tayeb, är en av grundarna av ISNA, en annan av de stora organisationer som grundats av Muslimska brödraskapet, och var även ordförande för Michigan-avdelningen av CAIR.

Det är inte bara El-Sayed, hans svärfar och hans fru som klassificeras som aktivister i islamiska organisationer kopplade till Muslimska brödraskapet, utan även hans syster och mor. Hans biologiska mor, Faten Fathi al-Koumi, arbetade för Islamic American Relief Agency (IARA), en organisation som anklagades för ekonomiskt samarbete med Osama bin Laden, Hamas och talibanerna, och som 2004 klassades som en terroristorganisation av det amerikanska finansdepartementet.
Hans syster, Eman Abdelhadi, skrev på X: "Jag hoppas att hela världen reser sig mot det amerikanska imperiet." Hon beskrev självständighetsdagen som en hyllning till stulen mark och Thanksgiving som en hyllning till folkmord och propaganda för amerikansk bosättarkolonialism, och hon stödde attacken mot Israel den 7 oktober. Hans nära vän, som driver mediemarknadsföring för sin kampanj, den islamistiske extremisten Hasan Piker, sade att Amerika förtjänade det som hände dem den 11 september.

Jag kan säga att de antiamerikanska, västerländska och israeliska anti-uttalanden som kommit från El-Sayed och hans familjemedlemmar bara är en liten bråkdel av vad de tror på. Det de döljer är mycket farligare.
Underligt nog kritiserar El-Sayed politiska pengar i val men förlitar sig på islamiska politiska pengar: hans svärfar donerade mer än 200 000 dollar till hans kampanj, och medlemmar i den islamiska organisationen CAIR donerade 115 000 dollar.

Zohran Mamdani, Abdul El-Sayed och andra muslimska kandidater förlitar sig i sina kampanjer på islamisk finansiering, muslimska volontärer och avgörande muslimska röster. De vill genomföra en vänster-islamisk agenda, och de anklagar alla som kritiserar detta för "islamofobi", El-Sayed kallade till och med president Trumps kritik av honom islamofobi. Ännu farligare kallade han kritik av sharia för en produkt av vit makt-rasism, och hans lögnaktighet nådde den punkt där brutal islamisk sharia jämfördes med katolsk kanonisk lag.

Arabiskspråkiga plattformar har fyllts med försvar av Mamdani och El-Sayed, en arabisk podcast i Amerika frågade till och med: "Vad är fel på El-Sayed om han verkligen är medlem i Brödraskapet?", trots att Muslimska brödraskapet klassat som en terroristgrupp av Vita huset. Och en muslimsk amerikansk universitetsprofessor av egyptiskt ursprung hävdade att "vi vill inte tillämpa vår islam i Amerika på amerikaner, utan på oss själva, vi muslimer", vilket betyder att han vill ha ett islamiskt getto som tillämpar sharia och islamiska värderingar som strider mot den amerikanska konstitutionen, lagarna och västerländska samhällens värderingar, och som står emot själva begreppet medborgarskap i den moderna staten!!(utanförskapsområden)

El-Sayeds ståndpunkt om Israel skiljer sig inte från Mamdanis: han beskriver Israel som en ond stat som har begått folkmord och praktiserar apartheid; han förkastar Israels rätt att existera som judisk stat; han vill skära ner det amerikanska stödet till den och avsluta allt amerikanskt militärt stöd; han vill att Netanyahu ska ställas inför rätta som krigsförbrytare; och han var en framträdande medlem av den anti-israeliska "Uncommitted"-rörelsen. 

Kort sagt, den som analyserar hela hans diskurs drar klart slutsatsen att han är antisemit och judehatare, ett grundläggande drag i den islamiska rörelsens diskurs, övertygelser och beteende.
Lägg därtill förstås hans radikala vänsteragenda: en återgång till kaoset med illegal invandring genom att avskaffa ICE; nationaliserar ägandet av artificiella underrättelseföretag; statlig hyresreglering; gratis allmän sjukförsäkring även för illegala invandrare; avskrivning av medicinska skulder; att betala skadestånd för det han kallar historiska orättvisor; införa en ny förmögenhetsskatt på 7 %; och naturligtvis framställer muslimer som offer för islamofobi.
Det är värt att nämna att El-Sayed sade att han förblev tyst om att fördöma Khameneis dödande av tusentals fredliga iranier för att inte förlora muslimerna i Michigan!!

Men frågan kvarstår: tillhör Abdul El-Sayed Muslimska brödraskapet?

Utifrån min studie av brödraskapets historia och islamiska rörelser genom islams historia, och från mina erfarenheter under årtionden av tv-sända debatter med högt uppsatta ledare inom brödraskapet och olika islamiska grupper, inklusive Mohamed Morsi, som jag debatterade med på Al Jazeera i november 2001 om septemberattackerna mot Amerika, och som senare blev Egyptens president,  Jag kan med säkerhet säga att Abdul El-Sayed är en fundamentalist som tillhör Brödraskapets tankeskola, bär dess agenda och mål om islamisering, och utövar dess metoder för bedrägeri och vilseledning. Utöver det var El-Sayed organisatorisk medlem i en organisation som Muslimska brödraskapet hjälpte till att grunda, Muslim Students Association (MSA); han samarbetade med CAIR och talade vid dess konferenser; han fick 115 000 dollar för sin kampanj från 41 personer, de flesta av vilka haft eller innehar positioner vid CAIR; och naturligtvis är hans svärfars relation med CAIR och ISNA dokumenterad, organisationer grundade av Muslimska brödraskapet eller av element som stödjer Hamas.

 (Från google: ”Qatar är den enskilt största utländska finansiären av högre utbildning i USA och har under de senaste decennierna kanaliserat miljarder dollar till västerländska universitet.”…den som äger läroplanen äger sinnet på framtiden…)
  
Den som har studerat islamiska rörelsers historia vet väl att de flesta islamiska organisationer runt om i världen, om inte alla, grundades av muslimska bröder, saudiska wahhabiter eller muslimska fundamentalister; Enkelt uttryckt grundades alla dessa organisationer av den organiserade islamiska rörelsen. De flesta islamiska organisationer i Amerika och väst, och även de flesta moskéer, särskilt under perioden 1960–2000, grundades genom samarbete mellan brödraskapets organisation och saudisk wahhabitisk valuta.¹⁰

Som ordspråket säger: om den går som en anka, simmar som en anka och kvackar som en anka, är det en anka. Allt som kommit från Abdul El-Sayed och hans familj bekräftar att de tillhör de extremistiska organisationerna inom den islamiska rörelsen och har nära band till Muslimska brödraskapet genom de organisationer som brödraskapet hjälpte till att grunda i Amerika.

Det började med Obama

Vi kan datera uppkomsten av den röd-gröna alliansen i Amerika till början av Barack Obamas presidentskap, som kombinerade vänsterpolitik med stöd för islamisk närvaro och islamisk uppgång. Frank Gaffney, grundare av Center for Security Policy, skrev en artikel och en bok om Muslimska brödraskapet under Obama-administrationen,¹¹ där han namngav många av de islamiska personer som befordrades under Obamas tid, såsom Mohamed Magid, som varit president för ISNA och som Obama gav en viktig post i Department of Homeland Security.  tillsammans med andra: Dalia Mogahed, Rashad Hussain, Huma Abedin, Farah Pandith, Kareem Shora, Mohamed Elibiary, Louay Safi, Kifah Mustapha, Azizah al-Hibri, Salam al-Marayati, Mazen Asbahi, Nawar Shora, Arif Alikhan, Eboo Patel...
Abdul El-Sayed planerar att följa i Obamas fotspår: från senator från Michigan till USA:s president.¹² Mamdanis och Abduls uppgång, ett kvarts sekel efter 11 september, är mycket farligare för Amerika än den 11 september själv.¹³

Sammansmältning av mål med vissa högerflyglar
En ny term har nyligen dykt upp: "röd-grön-brun." Det innebär att vissa islamiska organisationers mål har konvergerat med vissa falangar av den amerikanska högern (konvergens, inte allians). Tucker Carlson, till exempel, leder en bedräglig diskurs till försvar för islam, muslimer och de islamiska rörelserna; han upprepar den förfalskade islamiska historiska berättelsen om Palestina och är fientlig mot Israel. Kärnan i Carlsons diskurs är ett försök att skapa en kristen högerströmning i USA som är fientlig mot Israel i tjänst för den islamiska berättelsen, och att skapa en brytning mellan kristendom och judendom i islams syften. Det är därför en av den islamiska rörelsens ledare i New Jersey, Osama Abuirshaid, verkställande direktör för American Muslims for Palestine, erkände vid ett offentligt evenemang den 16 januari 2026 att de hade lyckats splittra MAGA-rörelsen inifrån; Jag tror att han syftade på vad Tucker Carlson och hans nuvarande gör. Det finns ihärdiga rapporter om Carlsons relation med Qatar, frågor som kräver säkerhetsutredning mer än de utgör forskningsmaterial.

Det bör noteras att den röd-gröna alliansen i Amerika väljer specifika städer där de ska utöka sitt inflytande genom kandidaturer till politiska ämbeten: Mångfaldiga städer med blandad invandrarbefolkning, städer med låg andel vita och kristna konservativa, städer med hög andel muslimer, städer kontrollerade av Demokratiska partiet, städer med ekonomiska och sociala problem,  städer som har blivit motbjudande för medelklassen och affärsmän, städer med en anmärkningsvärd närvaro av den radikala vänstern. 

Kapningen av det demokratiska partiet

I årtionden har den radikala vänstern eller radikalliberala strömningen kontrollerat skolorna, universiteten, större delen av amerikanska medier, Hollywood och sedan Silicon Valley, till den grad att sociala medieplattformar under Biden-åren utövade strikt censur av den amerikanska högern och kristna konservativas tillgång till sina plattformar, samtidigt som de öppnade fältet för woke-agendan och den röd-gröna alliansen.
Problemet är accelerationen av den så kallade progressiva strömningen inom Demokratiska partiet, som försöker kapa partiet helt. Denna strömning kallar sig Democratic Socialists of America (DSA), men i verkligheten skiljer den sig från de socialdemokrater eller socialdemokratier som fanns i Europa och Amerika. Denna strömning inom Demokratiska partiet är i själva verket demokratisk kommunism: de vill använda valens och demokratins mekanismer för att sprida en kommunistisk agenda, och låt oss inte glömma att Hitler såg sig själv som socialist.

Det som har hjälpt till med denna nuvarande uppgång i Amerika, som Fareed Zakaria säger, är det demokratiska partiets accelererande vänstersväng under de senaste tre decennierna: Obama var längre till vänster än Clinton, och Biden genomförde en större vänsteragenda än Obama. Zakaria påpekar att de som stödjer vänsteragendan inom Demokratiska partiet inte är de fattiga och arbetarna utan universitetsutbildade, vilket är precis vad som hände med El-Sayed i Michigan. Farligare, som Zakaria säger, är Demokratiska partiets antagande av den woke-agendan och dess situation kring brott, invandring och gränsen.¹⁴

Den islamiska rörelsen i Amerika ser i framväxten av denna radikala vänster inom Demokratiska partiet en egen möjlighet till politisk framgång, vilket är anledningen till att den har allierat sig med den. Den islamiska aktivisten Linda Sarsour var en huvudvolontär i senator Bernie Sanders kampanj, och Mamdanis och El-Sayeds segrar är frukten av denna allians.

Väsentliga observationer om den grön-röda alliansen

Denna allians hävdar att rättvisa kräver att systemet fälls och sedan hela koloniala väst. Ur dess perspektiv är Israels kollaps ett förspel till kollapsen av Israels skapare och stödjare i Amerika och väst, vilket är anledningen till att strömningen är så intensivt fientlig mot Israel.

Denna allians är inte intresserad av att kritisera tyranni, kvinnors förnedringade status, avsaknaden av mänskliga rättigheter eller förföljelsen av homosexuella i islamiska länder; den fokuserar uteslutande på väst.

Förföljelsen av kristna i Mellanöstern, Afrika och Asien får ingen som helst uppmärksamhet från denna allians. Även om vänstern är hård i sin kritik av kristendomen i väst, kommer den aldrig nära att kritisera islam, trots att kristendomen idag är världens mest förföljda religion och islam är den främsta förföljaren av kristna världen över.

Den islamiska sidan har påtvingat denna allianssammanblandning av islam och muslimer. Hur hård västerländsk tanke och västerländska domstolar än försöker skilja de två åt, insisterar det muslimska partiet på att blanda ihop dem; de islamiska organisationerna insisterar på att all kritik av islam är ett angrepp på muslimer, och hävdar att de representerar islam och muslimer tillsammans, trots att de inte är valda.

Vänstern försöker anpassa sig till varje filosofisk ståndpunkt för att hitta en rättfärdigande för att alliera sig med den islamiska rörelsen, från den iranska revolutionen till islamofobi till antisionism. Vänstern har också använt intersektionalitetsteorin för att placera alla former av klagomål i en och samma kategori, och använt denna intersektionalitet för att klassificera muslimer inte bara som en religion utan som en raslig och etnisk minoritet.

Rödgrön diskurs är blek och undvikande mot Iran, samtidigt som den är fientlig mot de moderata islamiska stater som är allierade med Amerika.
Denna allians arbetar, i samarbete med islamiska stater som sponsrar terrorism, för att kontrollera FN:s institutioner och använda dem för att uteslutande fördöma Israel.

Den islamiska rörelsen lärde sig också från den 11 september att undergrävning av Amerika och väst inte kommer att lyckas genom våld utan genom att infiltrera institutioner och sabotera dem inifrån, via en politik av allianser, invandring och fortplantning. Entrism.
Den radikala västerländska vänstern behandlar den islamiska rörelsen som en förföljd minoritet och förbiser dess våldsamma ideologi, fientlig mot alla västvärldens liberala demokratiers värderingar.

Islamisk finansiering av många amerikanska universitet har befäst alliansen mellan vänstern och den islamiska rörelsen på campus, med islamisk kontroll över Mellanösternavdelningar och påtvingandet av deras akademiska vision på dem.

(Från google: ”Qatar är den enskilt största utländska finansiären av högre utbildning i USA och har under de senaste decennierna kanaliserat miljarder dollar till västerländska universitet.”…den som äger läroplanen äger sinnet på framtiden…)

Den grön-röda alliansen blandar också fientlighet mot Amerika och väst med hat mot judendom och kristendom samt med teorin om anti-vit-man-fientlighet. Det är, kort sagt, ett giftigt hat mot allt västerländskt, kristet, judiskt, vitt eller kapitalistiskt.

Den västerländska vänstern har också hjälpt den islamiska rörelsen att organisera sig, nå massorna och förändra sitt hårdföra politiska språk till ett undvikande, vilseledande sådant, vilket påskyndar dess inträde i västvärldens politiska huvudfåra.
Vissa har varnat för faran att denna strömning har kapat svarta amerikaners orsaker och vävt in dem i sin agenda under sin teori om intersektionalitet.
Den röd-gröna strömmen konvergerar med Iran i att framställa Amerika som imperialismens ledare och därför, för båda, "den store Satan", som Khomeini kallade det.

De flesta muslimer som emigrerade från islamiska länder till väst bar med sig antisemitismens trosbekännelse, och genom sin allians med västvänstern höjde de nivån av antisemitism på vänsterkanten och därefter i hela väst, men denna gång under den palestinska sakens överskrift. Ordet "Palestina" har blivit nyckeln till antisemitism i väst idag och en källa till att elda på det hatet.
Västvänsterns brott är vad den lämnar osagt om islam och muslimer gällande våld, islamisering, sharia, kvinnors situation, avfallslagar och islamistisk terrorism, till den grad att en tysk vänsteraktivist sade, efter en bilpåkörning mot medborgare i Tyskland, 
"Jag önskar att gärningsmannen hade varit vit och inte muslim!!"

Vänstern förbiser också städerna som blivit halvstängda för alla utom muslimer. I Europa finns så kallade no-go-zoner; i Frankrike har 751 områden räknats som "känsliga stadszoner", resultatet av en allians mellan den islamistiska rörelsen, vänstern och kriminella gäng. I Amerika är Dearborn, Michigan mer en förlängning av södra Libanon än en amerikansk stad, och när du promenerar genom Paterson, New Jersey känner du att du är i Ramallah snarare än i Amerika.

Alliansens framtid och västvärldens framtid

Det finns olika teorier om denna alliansframtid.
Den pessimistiska synen är att denna allians kommer att leda till sabotage av väst inifrån, följt av dess fall. text:
The Evolution of the Stratocaster Pickup 1954-2026

The Stratocaster pickup has evolved from a simple electromagnetic transducer into a family of sophisticated passive, noiseless and active designs. Across seven decades, changes in magnets, winding wire, pole staggering, coil geometry and electronics have transformed its capabilities while preserving the familiar single-coil format.

1954 - Fender’s original Stratocaster pickups featured six Alnico 3 rod magnets, staggered pole heights, black fiberboard bobbins and 42 AWG Formvar-insulated winding wire. Typical vintage-style resistance is ~5.8kΩ, with ~8,000 turns often used as a reference rather than a universal factory specification. The stagger accommodated heavier strings and wound G strings.

1956-1965 - Fender transitioned to Alnico 5 magnets in late 1956, retaining Formvar wire and staggered poles. During the 1960s, plain-enamel wire increasingly replaced Formvar, while gray-bottom fiberboard bobbins appeared. Typical vintage-spec resistance remained near 5.8-6.0kΩ.

1974-1977 - Fender adopted flat pole pieces around 1974, reflecting changing string gauges and the widespread use of plain G strings. In 1977, five-position switching became standard, formalizing the neck/middle and bridge/middle combinations previously obtained by balancing three-position switches.

1980-1987 - DiMarzio’s HS-2 introduced stacked hum-cancelling coils in a Strat-width housing, using Alnico 5 magnets and four-conductor wiring. EMG developed active single-width pickups using internal preamplifiers, 9V power and typically 25kΩ pots. In 1987, Fender introduced Lace Sensor pickups on the Strat Plus, while the American Standard used a reverse-wound, reverse-polarity middle pickup for hum cancellation in positions 2 and 4.

1991-1998 - DiMarzio’s Fast Track 1 employed ceramic magnets and dual steel blades. Seymour Duncan Hot Rails offered high-output, ceramic-magnet rail humbuckers. Fender’s Texas Specials retained conventional Alnico 5 single-coil construction with hotter windings. In 1998, Fender introduced Vintage Noiseless pickups, using vertically stacked coils and Alnico 2 magnets.

2006-2015 - DiMarzio’s Area 58 refined stacked noiseless technology with Alnico 2 magnets and 6.15kΩ resistance. Fishman’s Fluence technology replaced conventional wire-wound coils with precisely manufactured layered structures, active electronics and selectable voices. Strat-width Fluence designs used Alnico 4 magnets and 9V power.

2017-2024 - Fender’s V-Mod pickups combined different Alnico grades for position-specific magnetic characteristics. V-Mod II refined the approach in 2020. The 2024 Ultra II Noiseless design employed Alnico 5 rods and calibrated stacked coils for hum cancellation.

2026 - Fender’s Silent System introduced a separate passive dummy coil beneath the pickguard, cancelling interference without stacking coils inside the primary pickups. Coastline ’57 single coils retained Alnico 5 rods and Formvar wire.

The central engineering lesson: DC resistance alone does not determine output or winding count. Magnet strength, turns, wire gauge, inductance, capacitance and coil geometry all matter. The Stratocaster pickup’s evolution is ultimately the history of balancing magnetic sensitivity, frequency response and electrical noise.

God used late Dan Orbih to make me governor in Rivers — Wike

Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Chief, Hon. Nyesom Ezenwo Wike - CON, GSSRS, has recounted how late Chief Daniel Orbih served as the divine instrument that paved the way for his emergence as the Governor of Rivers State in 2015.

Wike made the disclosure in Abuja on Wednesday, during a night of tributes in honour of Orbih, the National Vice-Chairman of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), South South.

Orbih from Etsako in Edo State died on Aug. 31 at 64.

Wike revealed the high-stakes political intrigues, extreme pressure, and financial inducements that Orbih, widely known as simply Dan, resisted to remain steadfast in supporting his gubernatorial ambition.

He traced the roots of their close bond to the critical political period between 2013 and 2014, describing it as a turbulent era where political adversaries made desperate attempts to derail his ambition.

"Today I am a Minister of the FCT; yesterday I was a governor. Who did God use for me to become governor? It was Dan," Wike said.

Recalling the intense pressure mounted by opponents, including the sitting governor of Rivers State at the time, Wike disclosed that massive inducements were offered to Orbih to withdraw his support, but he firmly refused.

"There was nothing in this world that was not done to induce him. My governor then sent people to Dan, offered him everything in this world, but Dan stood firm and said, 'No, I will not accept, I will not agree.'

The minister said that as the South South National Vice-Chairman of the PDP, Orbih backed his campaign by donating two bulletproof Mercedes-Benz buses to strengthen his security and mobilised massive structural support across the region.

Wike expressed profound admiration for Orbih’s rare selflessness, pointing out that throughout his eight-year tenure as Governor of Rivers State, Orbih never sought personal gain, patronage, or government contracts.

"Dan is not a typical Nigerian politician. Throughout my eight years as governor, he never came for one day—either by phone or coming to my house to say, 'I need this contract.' Never," he said.

He added that the loyalty and commitment demonstrated by Orbih were traits deeply rooted in his family heritage. 

"The only way I can identify a politician that is reliable is when that politician has stood in times of crisis. Loyalty, commitment to friendship, and being a brother's keeper run in Dan's family,” he said.

Wike stressed that without Orbih’s strength as National Vice-Chairman protecting the region's interests, many current national and state lawmakers would not have attained their positions today.

Highlighting Orbih's strategic foresight, Wike noted that the late political titan laid the foundation for cross-party collaboration in Edo and supported many politicians in the state but had not benefited from it. 

The FCT minister insisted that Orbih deserves a state burial considering his contribution to the political developments in Edo State and urged stakeholders from the state to do something about it. 

“I will continue to keep my relationship with Dan’s family. I think I will also discuss with the family on how to keep the legacies of Dan,” he said.

Also, Sen. Magnus Abe, Chairman of the Board of the Nigeria Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission, disclosed that he is a politician today because of Orbih explaining that it was the deceased that introduced him to politics.

“I was the Director General of his first campaign in the United Nigeria Congress Party, when he ran for governor and I went everywhere in Edo with him.

“Dan was indeed a bridge builder par excellence. We are gathered here today not because Dan is dead. We are gathered because of the life that he lived and that life impacted all of us in so many different ways,” he said.
