text:
Knowing What to Think
“It’s my truth,” she said.
Which one, I wondered.
Because I've been thinking about truth lately.
Not because I have suddenly figured it out.
Quite the opposite.
I’m starting to wonder how much of what I think I know is actually something I know.
And how much of it is something I was told.
Or something I saw.
Or something I searched for.
Or something an algorithm decided I should see.
Or something repeated so many times that eventually it felt like common knowledge.
I have biases.
A lot of them.
So do you.
Everyone does.
We see the world through the little collection of experiences, mistakes, victories, prejudices, fears, hopes and assumptions we've accumulated along the way.
That's being human.
If I see something happen nine times, I start expecting it to happen the tenth time.
That's not necessarily truth.
It's observation.
And observation can be wrong.
The problem is that we live in a world where observation is increasingly being replaced by information.
And information is increasingly being filtered.
Twenty years ago, I was learning about SEO.
Back then, we figured out how to manipulate search engines.
Stuff enough keywords onto enough pages.
Build enough links.
Get enough people pointing to your website.
And eventually the machines might decide that your website was important.
It wasn't necessarily true.
It was just really good at being found.
We learned how to manipulate the machines.
Then social media came along.
Now we didn't just get search results.
We got feeds.
And the feed learned what we clicked.
What made us angry.
What made us afraid.
What made us laugh.
What kept us scrolling.
And pretty soon two people could live in the same country, use the same internet and look at the same day's news...
and come away believing they were living in completely different realities.
Now we're moving into the next phase.
AI.
And AI doesn't simply give us search results.
It gives us a distillation.
A summary.
An answer.
A synthesized version of everything it has been trained on and everything it has been given access to.
Which is incredibly powerful.
And incredibly useful.
And, frankly, a little terrifying.
Because we are entering a world where knowing how to think may become more important than knowing what to think.
That's the part that worries me.
Not because I think AI is evil.
I don't.
I think AI could be one of the greatest tools humanity has ever created.
Imagine a world where machines handle ninety percent of the repetitive work.
Imagine people having time to study philosophy.
Learn an instrument.
Paint.
Garden.
Write.
Run.
Build things.
Teach their kids.
Take care of their parents.
Learn another language.
Start a business.
Read books simply because they are interesting.
Imagine human beings having more time to actually be human.
I want that world.
I really do.
But there is a darker possibility.
A world where we stop learning how to think because the machine will think for us.
Where we stop reading history because the machine can summarize it.
Where we stop examining opposing arguments because the algorithm already knows what we're likely to agree with.
Where we stop asking questions because we are given answers before we have even figured out what the question should have been.
And if the person or institution controlling the machine controls what information gets included, excluded, emphasized or minimized...
then we have a problem.
Because history has always had this problem.
Kings had scribes.
Empires had historians.
Governments had propagandists.
Newspapers had editors.
Television had producers.
Search engines have algorithms.
Social media has feeds.
And now we have AI.
Different technology.
Same old human problem.
Who gets to tell the story?
Who gets to decide what matters?
Who gets to decide which facts get remembered?
And which ones quietly disappear?
I don't have answers to those questions.
That's probably why I'm writing this.
I'm worried.
I can feel the world shifting.
Technology is changing faster than most of us can process.
Politics feels increasingly tribal.
People seem increasingly certain that their side possesses truth and the other side possesses stupidity, evil or both.
We have more information than any generation in human history...
and somehow seem less capable of agreeing on what actually happened yesterday.
That's weird.
And I'm not convinced we're handling it very well.
But here's where I keep getting stuck.
What the hell am I supposed to do about it?
I'm one guy.
I write books.
I make videos.
I run a little daily newsletter.
I sit in front of a computer and yell at the internet occasionally.
I'm not going to fix Washington.
I'm not going to fix Google.
I'm not going to fix AI.
I'm not going to fix humanity.
And neither are you.
But maybe that's the wrong question.
Maybe the question isn't:
How do I fix the world?
Maybe it's:
What can I do today that makes the tiny piece of the world I touch slightly better?
Because I still believe in that.
I believe in holding the door.
I believe in letting someone merge into traffic.
I believe in buying somebody a cup of coffee.
I believe in checking on an old friend.
I believe in saying thank you to somebody whose job is usually invisible.
I believe in picking up the piece of trash that isn't yours.
I believe in complimenting somebody when you notice they've done something well.
I believe in helping somebody without needing everybody else to know you helped them.
I believe in being patient with the cashier.
I believe in calling your mother.
I believe in forgiving somebody when you can.
I believe in being kind to the person who doesn't have anything to offer you in return.
None of those things will show up in a presidential poll.
None of them will move the stock market.
None will change an algorithm.
None will make the evening news.
But here's the interesting thing.
There are roughly 2,000 people who read this every day.
If every person reading this did five small acts of kindness this week...
That's 10,000 acts of kindness.
Not one giant act.
Not a revolution.
Not a movement.
Just ten thousand tiny decisions to make somebody else's day a little better.
And then imagine those 2,000 people each influencing five more people.
And those people influencing five more.
Suddenly we're talking about something.
Maybe not enough to change the world.
But enough to change someone's world.
Maybe that's where hope actually lives.
Not in Washington.
Not in Silicon Valley.
Not in an algorithm.
Not in some billionaire's plan for the future.
Maybe hope lives in ordinary people making ordinary choices over and over again.
Choosing patience instead of anger.
Curiosity instead of certainty.
Kindness instead of cruelty.
Thinking instead of reacting.
Helping instead of judging.
And maybe that's the thing I want most as the world shifts.
I don't want to become cynical.
I don't want to become so convinced that everyone else is stupid that I stop listening.
I don't want to surrender my ability to think because a machine can think faster.
I don't want to surrender my ability to hope because the world sometimes looks hopeless.
And I don't want to pretend I have answers when I don't.
I don't.
I'm worried.
I don't know where all of this goes.
Maybe we're building the greatest tool humanity has ever created.
Maybe we're building something we don't fully understand.
Probably both.
But tomorrow morning I'll get up.
I'll write.
I'll think.
I'll ask questions.
I'll probably get some things wrong.
And I'll try again.
And maybe 2,000 of us can do the same thing.
Five little acts.
Ten thousand little pieces of kindness.
Every week.
Maybe that doesn't change the world.
Maybe it does.
I don't know.
But right now, while everything seems to be changing...
I'll take a little hope wherever I can find it.
And I'll try to leave a little behind for somebody else.
That's probably a pretty good place to start.
Uh-oh...
Maybe we actually can make a difference.

"Minnesota small business owner Beth Benike was watching the Netflix show “Bridgerton” on Monday night when she noticed a familiar image in a political ad that aired during a commercial break: the exact shot of Democratic congressional nominee Jake Johnson from a photo she’d been in with him last year.

Except in this attack ad from Johnson’s opponent, Republican Rep. Brad Finstad, Benike wasn’t in the photo anymore. 

In her place, in what appeared to be an AI-generated image, was Democratic Gov. Tim Walz.

Just as bizarre to Benike is why Finstad, her congressman, was using a photo with her in it at all: she’s been a very public critic of his support for Trump’s tariffs.

After being named Minnesota’s Small Business Person of the Year in March 2025, Benike was making news days later talking about struggling because of Trump’s tariffs. 

She reached out to Finstad several times for help, but said he didn’t offer any. When she twice tried to meet with him in Washington, D.C., he declined. 

She met Johnson in April, when he heard her story and asked if he could come to her warehouse to learn more about tariffs.

That’s where they ended up in a photo together, and why Benike quickly recognized Johnson’s image in Finstad’s campaign ad. 

She said she remembers that day “really clearly,” including what Johnson was wearing and where they were standing in her warehouse.

“I was like, ‘You’ve got to be kidding me,’” Benike told HuffPost, with a weak laugh. “My own congressman wouldn’t even talk to me in my time of deepest need that he was directly impacting and continuing to make worse, and now he’s using a photo taken at my warehouse and took me out of it? Can you make someone feel any less significant?”

You can see the image for yourself. On the left, the real photo of Benike with Johnson, which he shared on Facebook in April 2025. On the right, the manipulated image of Johnson with Walz in Finstad’s campaign ad."

text:
Mid-America College of Funeral Service is a real, currently operating private nonprofit college in Jeffersonville, Indiana (Louisville metro area), at 3111 Hamburg Pike. It is part of the Pierce Mortuary Colleges network and specializes in funeral service education.

It traces its lineage to the Kentucky School of Mortuary Science (founded 1895 in Louisville) and the Indiana College of Mortuary Science (origins in 1905 in Indianapolis). Those institutions consolidated and adopted the Mid-America name in 1980 after relocating to Jeffersonville. The school describes itself as having more than a century of history in the field.

Its associate and bachelor’s funeral-service programs are accredited by the American Board of Funeral Service Education (ABFSE), a U.S. Department of Education-recognized agency. It is also authorized by the Indiana Commission for Higher Education. Public records and the school’s own site show continuous ABFSE accreditation dating back decades, with a reaccreditation announcement in 2025. Graduates of its accredited programs are prepared to sit for the National Board Examination, which many states use as part of funeral-director or embalmer licensure.

Current offerings center on an Associate of Applied Science in Funeral Service (in-person, online, and hybrid options). Some bachelor’s programs are in teach-out and no longer accepting new applicants. Enrollment is small, typically a few hundred students. The college’s website (https://t.co/FuionMT2I3) remains active, with classes listed for fall 2026.

An associate degree in funeral service from the school in 2001 is consistent with programs it offered at that time. Alumni listings from around 1999–2002 include graduates of its mortuary-science and funeral-service associate programs. Individual student records are not public, so attendance or graduation by any specific person cannot be confirmed or ruled out from open sources.

text:
It’s a long ass story (I didn’t feel like typing) so I just asked @grok and this is what it said 

I’ll look up what actually drove the hype around Toad Venom by Ronin. It got hyped because the flower actually smoked, then the story around it turned into a multi-year ownership fight that marketing amplified on purpose.
Toad Venom is the keeper from a 2021 pheno hunt of Ronin Seeds’ Animal Face × Sin Mintz. Sin Mintz is Sin Mint Cookies × Zkittlez; Animal Face is Seed Junky’s Face Off OG × Animal Mints. Green Dragon’s Glen S. and his team popped about 30 seeds in North Hollywood and kept one plant. They called her Becky. Glen’s own description of the find was that she didn’t win on bag appeal, but she smoked: cookie and Zkittlez candy over biting Animal Face gas, with a heavy body effect that reviewers described as almost paralytic. Reported THC sits in the high 20s to low 30s.
What turned a good cut into a phenomenon was the next step. Reporting from GreenState says the cut left Green Dragon without Glen’s authorization and landed at Ronin’s Oklahoma grow in 2022 under the name Becky. A Ronin employee renamed it Toad Venom for the “sinful animal” angle. Both sides mostly agree Ronin made the cross, named it, and marketed it, while Green Dragon selected the keeper. They do not agree on how the plant left the room. Archive Seed Bank later publicly called out people taking credit for Green Dragon’s work, and a February 2026 Mango After Hours episode put Jake from Ronin and Glen on the same show. Miami Mango summed the market up with a line already circulating in grower circles: there is no better weed to smoke than drama weed.
Ronin ran that drama as distribution. Jake is a former venture capitalist whose model is closely held cuts, limited drops, and social hype. The frog-head bags showed up at Spannabis 2024 before most people had smoked the flower. Jake has said he put out decoy cuts during the dispute, including something he described as rebranded Detroit Runtz, which made “is this real Toad?” the content engine. Scarcity did the rest: clone-only, one mother, clones reported at up to $5,000, East Coast pounds offered at $4,000–$10,000, and labeled eighths in Thailand reported around $150. Counterfeits then fed the loop, because buyers kept chasing the version that matched the story.
By early 2026 GreenState called it the year’s hottest strain. High Times later put it among strains of the month. In May, Ronin and Green Dragon ran dueling LA clone drops (about 200 cuts from Ronin at Goat Global on May 10, several hundred more from Green Dragon a week later), which is when “Hot Toad Summer” took off and the cut finally left pure rumor status.
The short version: a real one-in-thirty keeper with a loud candy-gas profile, locked behind clone-only scarcity, wrapped in frog branding, and kept in the feed by a public credit fight. The smoke started it. The drama is what made it everywhere.

As a child I was raised by a very patriotic family. 

I had relatives in public office. A judge. A grandmother that would have died for this country. An uncle who was a POW and later a state SCOTUS. We had Colonels and various levels of military members. My father was a Marine. I still have family members who serve today. 

What we didn’t have were discussions about party affiliations. No infighting- no one telling me what to believe. Instead everyone lead by example. 

My parents took us to church. We had family meals together. We respected Sundays. They were set aside for worship and family. 

To this day, I don’t know all of my families political affiliations. But judging by the content of character and demeanor- they are conservative and good natured. Happy and successful. 

I’m puzzled by people that rail against the goodness our country has to offer- as it is. I’m puzzled by people that want to burn down a Republic. 

Maybe I’ll stop posting and run for public office. 

It take a lot of time and effort and my family comes first, but like those that came before me- I love this nation- and I don’t want to be a taker- we have too many takers on the vine.

text:
This house shows it was sold in February for $5.5M

Important details about older CA real estate noting it as architecturally significant

It can be labeled that for marketing

But there is a definition for historical purposes which is very very important

I haven't found evidence this house is historically designated but I'm not saying it isn't either.

In CA there is historical designation of homes and then there is a Mills Act program with significant property tax savings offered

Step 1- the house must be historically designated by the state

Step 2- apply at the city if offered to Mills Act

Mills Act is a 10 year rolling contract and is recorded against the property so it conveys to the next owner

The Mills Act property taxes are calculated every year using a state mandated 3 way methodology and they take the lowest of the 3 values. 

You MUST read each contract because there are restrictions noted in there but also there are often items that must be cured

Have I seen homes that have had Mills Act for years but the owner did not fulfill the contract obligations, yes. This means they did none of the restorative work required and the owner pocketed the property tax savings

In homes that haven't sold in decades, sometimes the house will have historical designation but they never applied for Mills Act because their adjusted Prop 13 basis is so low that a cap rate value would be higher. Once it trades, usually the cap rate aka restricted value

I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

Prayer In Case of Surgery

Lord Almighty, I lift up this beloved one,  little baby girl, as she faces surgery. Protect her, guide the hands of doctors and nurses, and grant wisdom in every decision. Remove her fear, anxiety, and complications, replacing them with Your peace and assurance. Restore her health, strength, and vitality quickly, and surround her with Your loving presence. Comfort her heart, strengthen her spirit, and let Your healing flow through  little baby girl’s body. May they recover fully, trusting Your mercy and experiencing Your grace throughout this trial. Amen.

Lord Jesus, Divine Physician, we kneel before you. Because your love is all-powerful, we ask you to stretch forth your healing hand upon  little baby girl. Strengthen her to accept this cross of suffering, and if it be your will, grant  little baby girl a miraculous healing, that your mercy may be made known. Amen.

Lord Jesus, we come to you with faith and ask you to cover  little baby girl with your precious blood. Lord, grant  little baby girl your healing peace. Amen.

Hail, holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness and our hope. To you do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to you do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, your eyes of mercy toward us; and after this, our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of your womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

Immaculate Mother of God, Our Lady of Lourdes, you chose to appear in a desolate grotto to a simple child. We come to you with boundless confidence to implore your intercession. Look upon us with your merciful eyes, especially upon  little baby girl who suffers from breast cancer. Obtain for her the healing and relief that she seeks, and above all, grant her the strength to accept God’s perfect will. Amen.

text:
🥃 SCAPA 10 YEAR OLD – ORKNEY SINGLE MALT. (Amazon offer £37 usually £52.)

48% ABV | Orkney Islands | Scotland

A rather interesting single malt from Scapa Distillery, overlooking one of the most historically significant naval anchorages in Britain.

NOSE

Fresh green apples, ripe pears, honey and vanilla. Gentle citrus zest, floral sweetness and a subtle coastal freshness. A little tropical fruit begins to emerge.

PALATE

Smooth, creamy and surprisingly rich. Honey, vanilla custard, pineapple and sweet malt, followed by hints of mango, lemon and delicate oak spice. The 48% ABV gives it a satisfying body without overwhelming the lighter flavours.

FINISH

Medium length, with lingering honey, vanilla, citrus and a touch of warming cinnamon. A gentle maritime character and drying oak round things off.

⚓ A LITTLE HISTORY – SCAPA FLOW AND WW2

Scapa Distillery was established in 1885, overlooking Scapa Flow, the enormous natural harbour that became one of the Royal Navy's most important bases during both World Wars.

On 14 October 1939, German submarine U-47, commanded by Günther Prien, penetrated the British naval defences and torpedoed HMS Royal Oak at anchor.

The battleship sank with the loss of 835 lives, one of the Royal Navy's greatest tragedies of the early war.

The attack prompted the construction of the Churchill Barriers, massive causeways designed to prevent enemy submarines entering the anchorage. They remain in use today.

Scapa Flow had already witnessed another extraordinary event on 21 June 1919, when the interned German High Seas Fleet was deliberately scuttled following WW1. Fifty-two German warships were sunk, with several wrecks remaining beneath the waters today.

OVERALL IMPRESSION

An elegant, honeyed and tropical island malt, quite different from the heavily peated whiskies often associated with Scotland's islands.

At 48%, there's a welcome concentration of flavour and texture. A good example of how a relatively young single malt can deliver character without relying on heavy peat or excessive oak.

And there's something particularly fascinating about enjoying a dram produced beside waters that witnessed some of the most extraordinary events in British naval history.

U.S. HARDTECH:
- El Segundo's Amca won the first award under the Army's new fast-track advanced manufacturing program, re-engineering and producing radar and power parts for an unnamed priority missile system whose original supply has dried up. Amca buys aging, often sole-source parts makers and redesigns hard-to-get components with its own software. @AmcaInc 

- Torrance's Fortastra raised a $30M Series A led by First In for maneuverable spacecraft that guard satellites by staying close, watching nearby activity, and responding to threats. It went from seed round to its first spacecraft in orbit in about a year and signed a manufacturing partnership with Hadrian. 

- The Pentagon's in-house lender, the Office of Strategic Capital, offered Wolfspeed a conditional 30-year loan of up to $1.5B to expand silicon carbide and gallium nitride chipmaking for defense in North Carolina, New York, and Arkansas, with warrants for up to 7.5% of the company. It also offered PsiQuantum $150M for its quantum computer factory in Milpitas.

- El Segundo's Gallatin AI raised a $50M Series A with 8VC and Silent Ventures for logistics software that tracks fuel, munitions, medical supplies, and vehicle readiness for Army and Air Force units from Japan to Alaska to Europe. It's one of three El Segundo-area raises or awards today. @GallatinAI 

- General Dynamics named President Danny Deep, a 25-year company veteran who ran its Land Systems and Combat Systems units, as CEO starting January 1. Phebe Novakovic moves to executive chairman after leading the company since 2013.

- Massachusetts-based VEIR raised a $110M Series C co-led by Matter Venture Partners and Tyche Partners for superconducting cables that carry far more power into AI data centers in less space than copper. After a 3 MW demonstration, the money goes to manufacturing.

- Nucor is spending $105M to expand its utility pole plant in Crawfordsville, Indiana, adding about 100 jobs. 

- Austin's webAI won a $14.5M Army contract to run AI directly on devices soldiers already carry, so it keeps working when networks are jammed or cut off. It's part of an Army program built to field new AI in months rather than years. @thewebAI 

- Seattle-area startups raised a record $3.5B in the third quarter while U.S. venture funding fell 40% from the prior quarter, according to PitchBook. Hardtech drove it, with Stoke Space, Starcloud, and Hubble Network raising $1.6B combined.

- Pasadena's Oratomic raised a $475M Series B at a roughly $5.5B valuation, three months after a $300M Series A, to build neutral-atom quantum computers. CEO Dolev Bluvstein was pretty blunt to the WSJ: "We have no idea what the business models are going to be."

ALLIED HARDTECH:
- Germany approved four more MEKO A-200 anti-submarine frigates from TKMS, an option worth about €5.3B that brings the class to eight ships, with the first due in 2029. Berlin had abandoned its troubled F126 frigate program with Dutch builder Damen.

- Poland's state nuclear company told Westinghouse to start ordering long-lead parts, including the containment vessel, for its first AP1000 reactor. Polish suppliers that earn nuclear quality certification will compete for the work, ahead of first concrete in late 2028.

- UK-based Universal Quantum raised more than $100M in a Series A co-led by DCVC and Firgun Ventures for modular quantum computers built from trapped-ion chips. It's already delivering on a $77M contract for the German Aerospace Center.

Follow for more hardtech news!

"Guilfoyle allegedly pressed a Trump donor to pay her $100,000 American Express bill while promising him access. Text messages reported by The Wall Street Journal show Guilfoyle, now US Ambassador to Greece, asking Kentucky attorney and Trump donor Eric Deters for the money on July 3, 2025, just days before her confirmation hearing. 

“Honey please I need you to get this done for me today,” she allegedly wrote over Signal, attaching Amex payment instructions and adding, “It won’t show up anywhere if you wire money to American Express.” 

Deters had been seeking her help with his IRS tax and legal problems, and when he balked, she allegedly told him he “could be here meeting with Billy Long,” then the IRS commissioner. 

Deters says she promised to be his “Trump ride or die, forever and ever” if he paid, but he declined and says she “never came through on anything.”

The texts suggest Guilfoyle was worried about leaving a paper trail. “Eric, I really wish you would stop papering all these things,” she allegedly wrote in one message, urging him to call her on Signal instead. 

In another, she wrote, “What a nightmare you’ll literally cost me my ambassadorship stop writing.” Deters, who once paid Guilfoyle $300,000 to speak at a Covid-era event he founded in Kentucky, also gave $125,000 to a pro-Trump PAC in 2022. 

Guilfoyle’s lawyer, Jesse Binnall, disputed the authenticity of the messages but offered no specifics.

Marco Rubio refused to address the allegations while standing next to Guilfoyle in Athens. Speaking at the foot of his plane as Guilfoyle looked on, the Secretary of State said he was aware of the report but had no idea if it was true. 

“You guys walk around thinking that because some source told you something and you reported it, it’s the gospel. It’s not the gospel,” Rubio told reporters. 

A day earlier, he praised her as “a strong ambassador.” A US Embassy official said Guilfoyle was “fully vetted” by the Senate and remains committed to serving “with dedication and integrity.”

This is the second Wall Street Journal report raising serious questions about Guilfoyle’s conduct. Last month, the Journal reported that Guilfoyle told guests at a dinner that the US could bring about political change in Greece, invoking the collapse of Romania’s government. 

The same reporting found she promoted the interests of Greek construction and energy company Aktor Group and repeatedly brought its registered lobbyist, who was paid $160,000 by the company, into official meetings with foreign leaders, some of whom reportedly mistook him for her chief of staff. 

Rep. Gregory Meeks, the top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, has called for her removal if the allegations are accurate. 

The top Democrats on the House and Senate foreign affairs committees are now calling for an investigation, but Rubio would not say whether he’d open one."

text:
(September 30, 2026)
Jamieson Greer, United States Trade Representative, declaring the New Global Order of free-trade in the post-WTO era:

29:50 mark:
Ricardo Torres, Milwaukee Journal Sentinel: “Welcome to Milwaukee, home of Harley-Davidson. You and other delegations are going to the Harley-Davidson Museum tonight. Harley is caught in the tariff situation. Last year it said it paid $67 million in duties and is preparing to pay more than $90 million this year. Have you met Harley representatives? What can you offer Harley and similar Wisconsin companies?”

Greer: “Harley-Davidson executives have not contacted me on these issues or asked for a specific exemption. It is a great company because it sources a lot from inside the United States. In the 1980s and at other times it requested tariffs to protect itself from unfair foreign competition. As I understand it, much of what Harley sources comes from the United States. We are always happy to talk. A tariff is a fee on a foreign product made by a foreign worker in a foreign factory. If you make it in America and source in America with American workers, you don’t pay it. The vast majority of the $30 trillion U.S. economy is activity here. People say a state’s number-one trading partner is Canada or Mexico. That may be true of foreign partners, but the most important partner for any company is usually other Americans. Of a $30 trillion economy, about $3 trillion is international trade and $2 trillion is imports — a relatively small slice of a large economy.”

text:
STATES OF EMERGENCY ACROSS AMERICA — PLEASE JOIN ME IN PRAYER!

October 8, 2026

Across our nation, states are facing emergencies involving severe weather, flooding, wildfires, and other serious circumstances.

States with reported emergency declarations include:

Florida and Alabama — Hurricane-related emergencies.
New York — Measles-related public health emergency.
California and Washington — Wildfires and other disaster-related emergencies.

As we look at what is happening across our nation, I am asking everyone to come together in prayer.

Pray for the families who are suffering. Pray for those who have lost their homes, their belongings, and their sense of security. Pray for the emergency responders who are putting their own lives at risk to help others.

Pray for our brothers and sisters in Christ, the family of believers, that the Lord will strengthen them, protect them, and provide for their needs.

And most importantly, pray for those who do not know Jesus Christ.

Pray that through these difficult circumstances, hearts will turn toward Him. That those who have been walking in darkness will seek His Light. That those who have placed their trust in the things of this world will recognize their need for the One Who offers eternal life.

John 14:6 (NIV) reminds us that Jesus Christ is the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Him.

Psalm 46:1 (NIV) tells us that God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

2 Peter 3:9 reminds us that the Lord is patient, not wanting anyone to perish, however wanting everyone to come to repentance.

We do not know what tomorrow will bring. However, we know Who holds tomorrow.

May the Lord cover these communities with His protection according to Psalm 91. May He provide shelter, food, healing, and comfort to those in need. May He strengthen His people to become His hands and feet, reaching those who are hurting.

And may every person who does not know Jesus Christ come to know Him as Lord and Savior.

This is not the time to live in fear. This is the time to seek the Lord, stand firmly in His Word, love one another, and pray without ceasing.

1 Thessalonians 5:17 — Pray continually.

All glory to Jesus Christ.

Warning: recursive post

Also they're just freaking blankets. But they're SOFT. And made in the USA. And a super-detailed reproduction of my 2014 @SONIC_BLOOM festival painting that ended up on stickers all over the world and even inked on people's bodies, so I have a special fondness for this particular hummingbird. It was so windy on the Colorado festival grounds that year the painting felt like it was trying to fly away. And then eventually it did, halfway around the world to its buyer, a friend I'd made in Costa Rica whose job was saving tigers. Symbol and animal, here and there — the whole world felt like a single giant weave.

Surely part of the reason for this was that I was fresh off reading Richard Doyle's book Darwin's Pharmacy when I painted it — a book that made a huge impact on me and how I think about living systems and consciousness. In it, Doyle uses the evolution of plant-pollinator relationships to show us how the entire biosphere is a kind of continuous, folded attention landscape, a fractal ruffle of inter-becoming where species seduce each other into participation in symbiotic relationships that serve a cosmic prerogative to explore all of possibility through the constant remix of self-other boundaries. That the folds of a flower are a rhetorical device that invite pollinators into boundary dissolution, that the pages of a book do the same thing with the reader, that folds trouble those boundaries in the first place.

Along the way he offers a hypothesis that our ancestors' relationships with "ecodelic" plants led to the ineffable experiences that compelled us to evolve language in order to communicate the immensely meaningful stuff we just saw, and that eloquence as a performance of fitness drove our repeated selection for the features that made us into human beings. It's as luscious as it sounds: both rigorous and poetic, and a plausible case for art, love, music, and altered states being CORE to what we are.

Darwin's Pharmacy is a book about a weave, one in which all of us a threaded together. It sounds cliché but it's anything but when you actually experience this firsthand. Realizing that the pattern of reality is only even sensible in the first place because we are made out of relationships. I just took it literally and made a thing about it. 

(20 of them are up for grabs. Let me know if you would like one!)

Rabbi Tovia Singer is saying the altar is built, the stones are cut, the vestments and trumpets are ready, and the only thing left is carrying it up the Temple Mount. He points at Ezra 3 and says that is the script. It is not.

Ezra 3 already happened. The exiles came back from Babylon around 538 BC, Jerusalem was in ruins, and the first thing they built was an altar so they could offer the sacrifices the Law still required. The Temple foundation was not laid yet. That is why the altar came first. It was history under Moses. It is not an order to start killing bulls and goats again after the Cross.

Then he says a physical sanctuary strikes at replacement theology, and that this collapses what Christians and Muslims say about God being finished with the Jews. That is the smear. The Catholic Church does not teach replacement theology. That phrase was invented later so the Church’s reading could be painted as antisemitic. What she teaches is fulfillment. The promises were made to Abraham’s seed, and that seed is Christ. The gifts and the call of God are irrevocable. Romans 11:29. God did not reject the Jews. The Old Covenant is brought to completion in the Messiah, not tossed aside for a second people and a second altar.

Here is why a Christian should not be cheering this on. Hebrews 10 says the priests stood daily offering sacrifices that could never take away sins, and that where there is forgiveness there is no longer any offering for sin. The veil was torn when he died. He said the Temple he would raise was his body. John 2. One mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus. The Mass is that one sacrifice made present. It is not a warm-up for a restored animal altar in Jerusalem.

So an altar in a warehouse, silver trumpets, priestly vestments, a shofar on the Mount: that can all be true as news. It does not reopen a way of forgiveness the Son already closed. Supporting it is not loving the Jewish people. It is asking them to step back behind the Cross.

text:
One of my students is music mad. We have a thing each day where we have to introduce each other to a song we like and the other has to listen at least 5 times. 

This week, he's had the JCB song, The Boxer by Simon and Garfunkle, Buffalo Stance, Mr Wendle, and The Gambler by Kenny Rogers. 

He's given me, amongst other things, Mr Traumatik- Special Powers ft. Ego Trippin. 

So, Ive written a review: 

Mr Traumatik’s Special Powers is, at first glance, a song about drugs, sex, herbalism and having unusually heavy testicles.

That is, of course, only the surface reading.

What we are really dealing with here is a surprisingly thoughtful study of modern masculinity: a man attempting to make sense of love, sex, spirituality and his place in the universe, largely through the medium of hallucinogens.

“I’ve got special powers” sounds, initially, like straightforward boasting. But repetition changes it. By the fourth or fifth declaration, it begins to sound less like confidence and more like a man trying very hard to convince himself.

Freud would have enjoyed this enormously.

The romantic heart of the song arrives in the line: “When you leave your physical body, I’ll be there to catch you fall.”

Taken out of context, it is actually rather lovely.

Shakespeare promised immortality through verse. Byron had mountains, moonlight and oceans. Traumatik offers to supervise your astral projection while you are off your head on DMT.

Every generation finds its own language for devotion.

That is really what makes Special Powers interesting. It is full of tenderness, but the tenderness is constantly embarrassed by itself. Every time the song gets close to saying something genuinely sweet, it immediately retreats into drugs, sex, threats or bollocks.

This is, arguably, British masculinity in its purest form.

A man cannot simply say, “I care about you deeply.”

He must instead explain that his third eye is open, his libido is extremely high, he can throw fireballs and his testicles weigh roughly the same as a small bag of sugar.

There is something almost moving about it. Touching, even. 

The anti-consumerism is there too. Traumatik rejects ordinary material life in favour of plants, nature, incense and eventual self-sufficiency. Marx wanted to liberate man from the alienation of industrial capitalism.

Traumatik appears to want a tent.

Possibly several tents.

He is equally suspicious of journalism, organised society and conventional sources of truth, repeatedly assuring us that what he says is “factual”.

This creates a small philosophical difficulty, because he also claims to possess supernatural powers.

Still, Descartes had his method.

Traumatik has mushrooms.

Perhaps the finest moment is “my bollocks weigh a kilo”, a lyric which arrives with absolutely no warning and immediately destroys any possibility of taking the previous thirty seconds seriously.

Yet even this feels oddly necessary.

The song repeatedly builds towards transcendence and then kicks the chair away. Spiritual awakening, tantric sex, altered consciousness, universal truth -  bollocks.

Literally.

There is something rather clever in that.

Modern romance is rarely candlelight and sonnets. It is two damaged people finding each other in a ridiculous world and agreeing, for reasons neither entirely understands, to be ridiculous together.

Someone to burn incense with.

Someone to eat mushrooms with.

Someone who will catch you when your soul briefly leaves your body.

Someone who, crucially, is prepared not to ask too many questions about the kilo.

Underneath all the swagger, Special Powers is really quite old-fashioned.

It is a love song about wanting somebody beside you when reality becomes strange. Its no 10CC, Im not in love, but its arguably as tear jerking. 

★★★★★

A touching meditation on love, masculinity, altered consciousness and the logistical implications of exceptionally dense testicles.

https://t.co/vZM9LBcMpo @RoyalFamily @ChathamHouse @ClarenceHouse @10DowningStreet @andyburnham The 10 Most Beyond-Belief Parts of This Conversation
Based on the two transcript files, here are the 10 most extreme, conspiratorial, or factually unhinged claims made during the Sarah Westall / Michael Letts interview:

1. "Military tribunals have been initiated and indictments are forthcoming"
Letts claims military tribunals have been "created" and "charged," with indictments ready to be served against high-profile figures including Obama, Brennan, and Susan Rice. He presents this as an ongoing, real operation — while admitting the public won't see them until "the investigation is complete." This is a years-old conspiracy theory that has never materialized.
2. "68–70% of the deficit is caused by embezzlement, fraud, and stealing — almost 100% with interest"
Letts asserts that internal documents show most of the national deficit is due to stolen money, and that when you add interest on the stolen money, it approaches 100% of the deficit. He provides no source, no document, and no verification. This is an extraordinary claim presented as fact.

3. "We have two options: military tribunals or another revolution"
Letts frames the choice as either military tribunals or a 1776-style revolution — explicitly invoking the possibility of mass destruction and comparing it to dropping the atomic bomb in WWII. This is rhetoric that normalizes the overthrow of the civilian government.
4. "Congress is a mafia bigger than the mob ever was"
Letts claims the corruption is a global criminal organization "headquartered" in the US, controlling the world's most powerful military and wealthiest country. He says it's the "most elaborate, most sophisticated criminal organization ever to exist in history." This is hyperbolic conspiracy framing.

5. "FEMA didn't have money for North Carolina flood victims because it was transferred to illegals — and that's why they didn't care"
This is a distorted claim. Letts says FEMA's budget was moved to help illegal immigrants, which is why flood victims got no help. The reality is more nuanced (FEMA disaster relief funding is separate from other programs), but it's presented as proof of deliberate malice.
6. "They're stealing your tax money through NGOs, and Congress members sit on the boards"
Letts claims Congress creates thousands of NGOs to funnel government money, and that members of Congress serve on these boards and get paid substantial sums without even attending meetings. This is presented as the mechanism of theft — but no specific evidence is offered.

7. "They're propping up Andrew Tate and Pearl Davis to accelerate moral decay"
Westall claims she ran a "vocal print" analysis showing that figures like Andrew Tate and Pearl Davis are being propped up by the same forces to "help the moral decay quicken" and give people hopelessness. This is a conspiracy theory about influencer culture.
8. "The Christian base is being controlled by twisting scripture to destroy women"
Westall and Letts claim that there's a deliberate effort to use Christianity to attack women — telling them they need to be subservient and shouldn't vote — as part of a broader strategy to defang and control the Christian base. Letts, an ordained Baptist minister, validates this.

9. "The justice system is a kangaroo court — judges ignore the Supreme Court"
Letts claims activist judges simply "give a finger to the Supreme Court" and change a word or two in their rulings to defy them. He says the US has a "third world country kind of thing" because judges don't follow the rule of law. This is a sweeping indictment of the entire judiciary.
10. "We're in a PSY-OP war — they're so good at making it look like they care"
Both speakers repeatedly frame everything as a "psychological operation" and "psy-op war," claiming the media, tech companies, and influencers are all part of a coordinated effort to manipulate the public. This framing allows any contradictory evidence to be dismissed as part of the psy-op.
